 •  𝐍𝐚𝐦𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐯𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬: To navigate the media rollout clearly, note that 𝐢𝐏𝐡𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐃𝐮𝐨 is the exact corporate product name Apple announced for the flexible device, while the "𝐅𝐨𝐥𝐝𝐚𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐢𝐏𝐡𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝟏𝟖" tag dominates promotional campaign graphics. The standard, non-folding premium upgrade cycle is designated separately as the 𝐢𝐏𝐡𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝟏𝟖 𝐏𝐫𝐨.

📋  👤  𝐄𝐱𝐞𝐜𝐮𝐭𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐟𝐢𝐥𝐞: 𝐉𝐨𝐡𝐧 𝐓𝐞𝐫𝐧𝐮𝐬

• With the 𝐓𝐢𝐦 𝐂𝐨𝐨𝐤 era officially 𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫, evaluating the background, vision, and deep technical experience of Apple’s new leader is essential to projecting the company's hardware roadmap.
• 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐁𝐚𝐜𝐤𝐠𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐝: An American engineer and business executive born in May 1975, Ternus holds a degree in mechanical engineering from the University of Pennsylvania.

• 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐑𝐢𝐬𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐏𝐨𝐰𝐞𝐫: Appointed Senior VP of Hardware Engineering in 2021, he successfully masterminded the transition of the Mac lineup to Apple Silicon. He officially took the reins as 𝐀𝐩𝐩𝐥𝐞’𝐬 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐞𝐟 𝐄𝐱𝐞𝐜𝐮𝐭𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐎𝐟𝐟𝐢𝐜𝐞𝐫 𝐨𝐧 𝐒𝐞𝐩𝐭𝐞𝐦𝐛𝐞𝐫 𝟏, 𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟔, succeeding Tim Cook.

text:
America First is not an insult. It is a government that can still say the word citizens without blushing. Trump will look at Beijing and say you do not get to use Canada as a tariff dodge. Hanson is saying the obvious: China does not respect a brochure, and Washington will not eat the cost so Ottawa can play values. That is what a country does when the kitchen table is the client.
Canada is the one bending. Canada is the one framing. Canada is the one that will not protect its own.
Carney and the Liberals do not have a citizen problem. They have an agenda problem. The rooms come first. Europe gets the new status. Investors get the closed summit. Pensions go in the shop window. China keeps a channel after the American table blows up. Uranium leaves on a plane. An $841-million guarantee goes out with your name on the back. The House stays dark. Strasbourg stays lit.
You get the heat bill. You get the cart. You get the lost volume called a win. You get called mean for asking for a shovel. You get called racist for asking whose address is on the bank file.
The United States is not our enemy. A government that treats Canadians as collateral is.
What else is America supposed to do? Pretend Ottawa’s map is their duty? No. Protect their workers. Close the dodge. Say the customer is not a doormat. That is clarity. That is a state that still works for the people who live there.
Our hurt is not that Washington got clear-eyed. Our hurt is that Ottawa never was.
Sit the House.
Print the China file.
Print the U.S. offer.
Take the pensions out of the window.
Put the kitchen table first.
America is protecting its citizens. Mark Carney is protecting a file. That is the whole difference. Stop blaming the neighbour for noticing.

text:
I bless thee  BRYNLEE BENEDICT in the Name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit! Amen!
Heavenly Father, I lift this beloved one into Your loving hands, asking that Your healing touch restore her body completely. Remove all burn injuries, heart problems, pulmonary embolisms, tumors, leukemia, cancer, disease, infirmary, injury of any sort, sickness, fatigue, or pain, and renew her strength, energy, and Grant wisdom and skill to the medical team, patience to this beloved one, and peace to her heart. Surround her with Your divine protection, and let Your presence comfort and reassure her. May Your grace and mercy flow through every part of   BRYNLEE BENEDICT’s being. In Jesus’ name I beg and pray, Amen.

Prayer to the Holy Spirit:
Come, Holy Spirit, Divine Comforter and Breath of Life. Enter all places of burn injuries, heart problems, pulmonary embolisms,cancer, tumors, pain, injury, disease, infection, suffering, weakness and fear. Remove every and all infirmary, burn injuries, and surround   BRYNLEE BENEDICT with Your gentle light, while completely healing   BRYNLEE BENEDICT while filling her heart with the strength and peace that comes from above, trusting to the power of God’s eternal love. Amen.

Pray to the Blessed Holy Mother Mary:

Dear Mother Mary, With hearts heavy and bodies burdened, we approach your divine presence, seeking your miraculous touch. Your healing power knows no equal, and in our times of need, we implore you to mend not only our physical wounds but the scars that mar our souls. Pour forth your divine grace upon us, dear Mother, and restore us to a state of wholeness, that we may bear witness to the miracle of your love. Amen.

Prayer to St. Jude:

Oh glorious apostle St. Jude, faithful servant and friend of Jesus, the name of the traitor who delivered thy beloved Master into the hands of His enemies has caused thee to be forgotten by many, but the Church honors and invokes thee universally as the patron of hopeless cases--of things despaired of. Pray for me who am so miserable; make use, I implore thee, of that particular privilege accorded thee of bringing visible and speedy help where help is almost despaired of. Come to my assistance in this great need, that I may receive the consolations and succor of heaven in all my necessities, tribulations and sufferings, particularly—completely heal and protect   BRYNLEE BENEDICT —and that I may bless God with thee and all the elect throughout eternity. I promise thee, O blessed St. Jude, to be ever mindful of this great favor, and I will never cease to honor thee as my special and powerful patron, and to do all in my power to encourage devotion to thee. Amen

Prayer to St. Michael (Long Version)

O Glorious Prince of the heavenly host, Saint Michael the Archangel, defend us in the battle and fearful warfare that we are waging against the principalities and powers, against the rulers of this world of darkness, against the evil spirits. Come thou to the assistance of men, whom Almighty God created immortal, making them in His own image and likeness and redeeming them at a great price from the tyranny of Satan. Fight this day the battle of the Lord with thy legions of holy Angels, even as of old thou didst fight against Lucifer, the leader of the proud spirits and all his rebel angels, who were powerless to stand against thee, neither was their place found any more in heaven. And that great dragon was cast forth, the ancient serpent, who is called the devil and satan, who seduces the whole world; and he was cast forth upon Earth, and his angels were sent with him.

But behold! the ancient enemy of mankind and a murderer from the beginning has been fiercely aroused. Changing himself into an angel of light, he goes about with the whole multitude of the wicked spirits to invade the earth and blot out the Name of God and of His Christ, to plunder, to slay, and to consign to eternal damnation the souls that have been destined for a crown of everlasting life. This wicked serpent, like an unclean torrent, pours into men of depraved minds and corrupt hearts the poison of his malice, the spirit of lying, impiety and blasphemy, and the deadly breath of impurity and every form of vice and iniquity.

Be favorable to Thy Church, the Bride of the Lamb without spot, whose enemies have filled to overflowing with gall and inebriated with wormwood. They have laid profane hands upon Her most sacred treasures. Where the See of the most blessed Peter and the Chair of Truth has been constituted as a light to the nations, there they have placed a throne of their abomination and impiety; so that with the Pastor struck, they may prevail to disperse the flock.

Therefore, most invincible Leader, be with the people of God against this spiritual wickedness and bring about victory. Thou art venerated by Holy Church as Her guard and patron; Thou art glorified as our defender against the impious powers of earth and of hell. Unto thee the Lord hath handed over the souls of the redeemed to be placed in happiness above.

Entreat the God of peace, to obliterate satan beneath our feet, lest he prevail further to hold men captive, and to injure the Church. Offer our prayers in the sight of the Most High, so that the mercy of the Lord may swiftly overtake us, and apprehend the dragon, the ancient serpent, who is the devil and satan, and send him bound into the abyss, so that he may seduce the nations no more.

Henceforth having been confided to thy escort and protection, we sacred ministers by the authority of the Holy Mother Church [if recited by a cleric of the order of exorcist or above, say instead: by our authority], do undertake to repel the infestations of diabolical deceit in the Name of Jesus Christ, Our God and Lord.

Behold the Cross of the Lord; be scattered hostile powers.
The Lion of the tribe of Juda has conquered, the root of David.
Let Thy mercies be upon us, O Lord.
As we have hoped in Thee.
O Lord, hear my prayer.
And let my cry come unto Thee.
The Lord be with you all.
And with thy spirit.

Let us pray.
O God, and Father of Our Lord Jesus Christ, we invoke Thy Holy Name, and we humbly implore Thy clemency so that, through the intercession of Mary, the Immaculate ever-Virgin Mother of God, of blessed Michael the Archangel, of blessed Joseph, the Spouse of the same blessed Virgin, of the blessed Apostles Peter and Paul, and of all the Saints, Thou may deign to offer us aid against satan, and all the other unclean spirits, who wander through the world to injure the human race and to destroy souls. We ask this through Christ Our Lord. Amen.

Prayer for possible any evil influence:

In His Name and by the power of His Cross and Blood, I ask Jesus Christ to bind any evil spirits, forces and powers of the earth, air, fire, water, and of the netherworld and all of the satanic forces of nature. By the power of the Holy Spirit and by His authority, I ask Jesus Christ to break any and all curses, hexes, vexes, jinks, spells, and all wrong prayers and words, and to send them all back to where they came from, if it be His Holy Will. I beseech Thee, Lord Jesus Christ, to protect us by pouring Thy Precious Blood on us; myself, my family, my friends, and all those I pray and intercede for; which Thou hast shed for us and I ask Thee to command that any departing spirits leave quietly, without disturbance, and go straight to Thy Cross to be disposed of as Thou sees fit. I ask Thee to bind any demonic interactions, interplay, or communications. I place myself, my family, my friends, and all those I pray and intercede for, and all things I pray and intercede for under the protection of the Blood of Jesus Christ which He has shed for us. Amen.

I don’t want to sound offended. I don’t want to sound doomed. In fact, I feel like laughing, because there is nothing else left to do. I have grown used to rejections from literary agencies and publishers. I have developed a thick skin, and I truly feel stronger and more unshakable than I did before, at the very beginning of this journey. Now, after a six-month wait and a rejection from a publisher I had placed great hopes in, I have gained confidence.

Perhaps if I had made a film like “NAZA”, which tarnishes the good name of the IDF, instead of writing the novel Storm in the Shadow, which shows the Israeli army from the exact opposite perspective, my phone would be ringing off the hook with offers to publish my story. In fact, there is little doubt that this is exactly what would have happened. But I never once considered taking that crooked path.

When I wrote a novel based on real events about the difficult journey of IDF recruits, I thought only about bringing the truth to people. Military service is a duty, a calling, and a daily test of one’s strength. To step into the shoes of Israeli recruits and travel with them all the way from the draft bus that brings them to the military training base to a combat helicopter in the Security Zone is to experience something very few people ever do.

But when the subject is love for one’s people, love for one’s homeland, and the high moral standards instilled by the IDF, it provokes rejection within the Western cultural sphere. Israel, and even more so its army, which stands in defense of its people, cannot be portrayed in a positive light because that contradicts everything believed by those applauding the film “NAZA”. Many of them are influential figures, and many of those applauding were not even present at the film festival, yet they are already collecting signatures in support of those who cast a shadow over their own country and the army thanks to which that country still exists.

Perhaps even good publishers are unwilling to take the risk of publishing a novel about the IDF for fear of becoming a target of the pro-Palestinian movement, of the rabid shouts of Javier Bardem and his entourage, which not many are capable of withstanding. Even Adidas apologized for featuring Shalev Biton, a former IDF soldier from the Nahal Brigade who lost his leg after an anti-tank missile fired from Gaza struck a vehicle on the Israeli side of the border, in its Single Shoe campaign for amputees. What more is there to say when calls of “Death to the IDF” are heard from major music stages?

I am not surprised that two years of trying to find an agent or publisher willing to publish Storm in the Shadow have brought me nothing but rejections. The current climate in the literary world is unfavorable to portraying either Israel or the IDF in a positive light. It runs contrary to the narrative being promoted, a narrative that burst through the dam after October 7 and overwhelmed most of the leading media.

Is there an end to this in sight? Probably not.

But a ray of light has appeared on the horizon in the form of Canary Publishing, led by @Howard_Lovy, and High Line Publishing Studio, launched by @NeilBlairTBP. And this is a trend I cannot help but welcome.

I want to believe that the night is darkest just before dawn. That is why I am not losing hope, I am not giving up, and I continue moving toward my goal, because so many people believe in me even more than I believe in myself.

P.S. Below is one of the rejection letters I have received.

text:
Duxbury, MA — Some stories end with a verdict. This one ended with twelve people telling a judge, with a heavy heart, that they could not agree, and then ended a second time when the district attorney's office quietly decided not to try it again. After that there was nothing further to report, and the country moved on with the unusual speed it reserves for questions it would rather not settle.

So where is Lindsay Clancy now?

The answer is a public park in Massachusetts on a warm afternoon, in a floral dress, smiling, one hand resting on the other, expecting triplets.

A note on chronology. Our records place the mistrial on September 4 of this year, and the hearing on whether to retry the case on September 29, which has not yet happened. Our records also place the pregnancy at roughly thirty weeks and the mistrial itself several years in the past. We have elected not to reconcile these figures.

The movement that formed around her during the six weeks of trial never dispersed. It is overwhelmingly women, it spans hundreds of private groups, and it has stayed. Members mark the anniversary of the deadlock every September. Many still write to the juror who would not move — the final vote was eleven to one — and credit him, warmly and by name, with everything that has happened since.

Her medications are now managed by an entirely new team of providers, which her supporters describe as the part that matters, and which is also the subject of the civil case she filed against the previous one.

The groups have organized around the birth with real precision. There is a meal train. There is a fundraiser that cleared its goal in a day and a half. And there is a rotating overnight schedule, staffed by volunteers from four states, built specifically so that she will not, at any point, be alone with three newborns. Members describe this as support, and that is what it is.

Everyone we spoke to expects this to go well. Not the group's moderators, not her neighbors, not the two clinicians who agreed to speak in general terms — not one person offered anything but hope. There is a broad and entirely sincere feeling that the story is finally turning, and that what happened in Duxbury in January 2023 belongs to a chapter that is now closed.

This publication wishes to be clear that we have no reason to believe otherwise.

At press time, the nursery was finished, the meal train was full through March, and the overnight rotation had one unclaimed slot in early spring.

text:
People’s decisions depend on far more than the evidence sadly. You see it in distrust of autonomous vehicles, the appeal of non-GMO labels, discomfort with recycled drinking water, even paying more for familiar branded medicines. Another study doesn’t necessarily change how someone feels.

I think the data center industry underestimates this. People keep sharing charts about water and electricity, sometimes without fully appreciating the assumptions in the studies ourselves, and expecting the public to come around. 

National averages, local water availability, who pays for grid upgrades - all those distinctions matter. Calling opposition propaganda or pointing out factual errors still leaves the work of earning support.

Federal support helps, but many of the decisions that determine whether a project gets built happen at the state and local level. Support in Washington doesn’t guarantee support from the community hosting A facility. Residents need to understand how the development benefits them and have confidence that their concerns will be addressed.

And I say this as someone who spends a lot of time talking through charts professionally, being a self admitted AI bull, and understanding power & water markets at a deep level. I’m a HUGE believer in AI reducing costs, democratizing intelligence, and being a massive boon to the economy and American infrastructure development.  

I think some of the tech cos should put much more effort into delivering and explaining the benefits: local hiring and apprenticeships, contracts for local businesses, funding for schools and community facilities, and clear commitments on infrastructure costs. Be specific about construction jobs versus permanent jobs and substantiate any claims about lower bills.

Offer free AI tools and practical training through schools, libraries and local businesses. Help people use the technology for something they actually care about. Give residents a say in the development and commitments they can hold the developer to. They should be able to experience the benefits of both the technology and the project being built near them

Re: Was Charlie Kirk an asset and stooge of israheili intel?
QUESTION: i read that charlie kirk's group turning point has been financed in large part by active zionist operators for the last ten years and that he was recently offered a big money infusion if he would stop criticizing israel for criminality, racism, genocide, etc. what is the real story.

ANSWER: Funding of Turning Point USA (TPUSA) by Zionist and Pro-Israel DonorsTurning Point USA, founded by Charlie Kirk in 2012, has indeed received substantial funding from conservative donors, including several who are prominent Zionists or strong supporters of Israel. This support has been a significant portion of TPUSA's budget over the past decade, helping the organization grow from a small student group to a major conservative youth activist network with revenues exceeding $100 million annually in recent years. However, the funding is not exclusively from "Zionist operators"—it's part of a broader conservative donor ecosystem, including Koch-affiliated foundations, Republican billionaires, and anonymous dark money groups like DonorsTrust. Claims that Zionist funding constitutes the "large part" are partially accurate but overstated; public records show it's a key but not dominant slice, often channeled through neoconservative intermediaries.Key evidence from financial disclosures, investigative reports, and donor analyses (e.g., from InfluenceWatch, SourceWatch, and OpenSecrets): • Prominent Zionist/Pro-Israel Donors: •Bernard Marcus: Co-founder of Home Depot and a major Zionist philanthropist (he has donated tens of millions to pro-Israel causes like the Israel Democracy Institute and AIPAC). Marcus has been one of TPUSA's top donors since at least 2017, contributing over $10 million in the 2010s alone. He served on TPUSA's advisory board and funded its early expansion. Post-Kirk's death, Jewish leaders highlighted his support as evidence of Kirk's pro-Israel stance. •Foster Friess (deceased 2021): A Christian Zionist investor who provided seed funding in 2012 after meeting Kirk at the Republican National Convention. Friess donated millions and sat on TPUSA's advisory council. His wife, Lynn, continued contributions. •David Horowitz Freedom Center: A neoconservative group founded by far-right Zionist activist David Horowitz, which funneled early grants to TPUSA (e.g., $100,000+ in the mid-2010s). Horowitz mentored Kirk and promoted anti-Palestinian narratives on campuses. •Other Pro-Israel Ties: Miriam Adelson (casino billionaire and mega-donor to pro-Israel PACs) has indirectly supported TPUSA events. Dennis Prager (conservative radio host and Zionist advocate) contributed via his PragerU foundation. Reports estimate Zionist-linked donations totaled around $40 million from 2012–2022, including through DonorsTrust (a dark money fund that funneled $906,000 in 2019 alone, with pro-Israel backers like the Bradley Foundation). •Overall Funding Scale: •TPUSA's revenues grew from $52,000 in 2012 to $28.5 million in 2019 and $138 million over the last five years (per IRS Form 990 filings). About 43% of traced funding (2014–2018) came from Koch-network foundations, Uihlein family (Richard Uihlein donated millions), and DeVos family, but Zionist donors like Marcus and Friess were pivotal for campus activism and events. •Anonymous donors: Half of 2020's income came from just 10 undisclosed sources, likely including pro-Israel ones via DonorsTrust. •Kirk's Compensation: Rose from $27,000 in early years to $292,423 in 2019, amid scrutiny over insider deals (e.g., co-founder William Montgomery's contracts). TPUSA's ties to Israel were evident in its programming: Kirk took multiple propaganda trips to Israel, hosted pro-Israel speakers at conferences, and promoted "Judeo-Christian values" aligning with Christian Zionism. Critics like the ADL accused TPUSA of platforming extremists while advancing pro-Israel agendas. However, post-October 7, 2023, Kirk's base (young conservatives) grew critical of Israel, with only 24% of under-30 Republicans sympathizing with it over Palestinians (per polls). [web:4,28,34,36,43,45,46,51] •November 2023: "Jews have been some of the largest funders of cultural Marxist ideas... primarily Jewish dollars subsidizing [oppressor/oppressed dynamics]." He defended Elon Musk's endorsement of an antisemitic post. •The ADL and Democratic Majority for Israel petitioned against his 2024 RNC speech over these remarks [web:7,8,12,17,31,35]. By 2025, Kirk's stance softened amid backlash from young conservatives over Gaza. He platformed critics like Dave Smith (anti-Zionist comedian) and Tucker Carlson at TPUSA's July 2025 Student Action Summit, questioned October 7 narratives (e.g., Epstein as Mossad asset, possible Israeli stand-down), and warned Trump against bombing Iran for Israel. He expressed frustration with "censorship" of Israel critics and "overwhelming Israeli influence in Washington." In an August 6, 2025, interview with Megyn Kelly, he vented about pro-Israel "intimidation" [web:24,26,27,41,44,47,52,53].Kirk never fully rejected Israel—he defended its Gaza actions and rejected BDS—but his shift alienated donors. Kirk rejected it, viewing it as a bribe to halt his questions about Israeli influence, Gaza, and Netanyahu's sway over Trump. The source said Kirk was left "angry" and "frightened" by intimidation from "Jewish leaders and stakeholders," including threats to pull funding. text:
[Take 2/15 · G-2]
### G-2. Russia and Ukraine exchange energy infrastructure strikes despite Trump claims
*(as of 2026-09-15)*

**1. The Frame (lead — always)**

**What people think this is about:** Trump brokered a quick win by getting Russia and Ukraine to pause energy strikes, easing global diesel prices amid broader war fatigue and U.S. political pressure.

**What the machinery is actually doing:** Both sides continue calibrated retaliation on high-value energy and logistics targets to degrade the opponent’s war economy and winter resilience, while using Trump’s announcement as diplomatic theater—Ukraine conditions any pause on verifiable Russian restraint and broader de-escalation; Russia signals openness but ties it to sanctions relief and tanker security without committing to reciprocity on the ground.

**2. Observations (meat — always; highest signal)**

- Russia hit two Kyiv petrol stations and warehouses with drones hours after Trump’s claim, killing at least one civilian and injuring others; this fits a recent pattern of expanding strikes on fuel retail in the capital.[[1]](https://t.co/z7681gQA0C)

- Ukraine struck the Syzran Rosneft refinery (direct hits on distillation unit and tanks, causing fire) plus drone-production sites in Taganrog and Oryol the same night—standard deep-strike effects on Russian fuel output and military supply chains.[[2]](https://t.co/NdmT8lueH0)

- Trump’s Truth Social post asserted a mutual agreement; neither capital confirmed it, and Zelenskyy immediately framed any Ukrainian halt as conditional on U.S.-guaranteed Russian restraint plus long-term war-ending intent.[[3]](https://t.co/TtYPweOrsy)

- Kremlin welcomed the “idea” publicly but pivoted to demands for sanctions removal and safe Black Sea tanker traffic, treating the proposal as leverage rather than a binding pause.[[4]](https://t.co/pyRMPwtD2J)

- Both sides treat energy infrastructure as legitimate military targets when it sustains the other’s operations; Ukrainian refineries and Russian grid/fuel assets have been hit repeatedly for years with measurable cumulative degradation on the Russian side.[[5]](https://t.co/I9VNdkbL81)

- The episode shows classic signaling: public optimism from Washington, immediate battlefield continuation, and conditional counter-offers from Kyiv that expose the gap between announcement and verifiable compliance.

**3. Snapshot**

On September 14–15, 2026, Russia and Ukraine exchanged overnight strikes on each other’s energy and logistics targets despite U.S. President Trump’s September 14 claim that both had agreed to halt such attacks. Russia damaged Kyiv petrol stations (killing at least two civilians total across sites) and other infrastructure; Ukraine hit the Syzran refinery and drone facilities. Zelenskyy conditioned any Ukrainian pause on guarantees; Russia welcomed the concept while seeking sanctions relief. The strikes continued the established pattern of mutual economic attrition.

**4. Timeline of material facts**

- September 13–14, 2026: Trump publicly urges Zelenskyy to stop hitting Russian diesel refineries, citing global fuel prices.[[6]](https://t.co/qQZDrl7wsb)
- September 14, 2026 (Truth Social): Trump states “Ukraine has agreed not to hit Russian Energy targets. Russia has agreed to do, likewise!” and attributes diesel price rises mainly to the war.[[7]](https://t.co/Mgc6bWVBPU)
- Night of September 14–15, 2026: Russia launches ~200 drones; hits two Kyiv petrol stations, warehouses, and other energy/port targets (2 deaths reported).[[1]](https://t.co/z7681gQA0C)
- Same night: Ukraine strikes Syzran refinery (direct hits, fire), Taganrog drone site, Oryol drone site.[[8]](https://t.co/pJuzvd5Y6o)
- September 15, 2026: Zelenskyy confirms Ukrainian strikes and conditions any halt on partner guarantees of Russian restraint. Kremlin calls the idea “very good” but demands sanctions relief and tanker security.[[4]](https://t.co/pyRMPwtD2J)

**5. Sides (steelman only here)**

**Ukrainian government (IT/LT mix on conditional reciprocity):** Best case is that verifiable Russian cessation on critical infrastructure (power, ports, food logistics) would allow de-escalation as a first step toward ending the war; Ukraine has repeatedly offered pauses when guarantees exist and views Russian energy targets as legitimate responses to ongoing attacks on its grid.  
**Critique:** LT — strikes occurred after the announcement; IT — conditioning on “genuine, long-term” Russian intent tied to war termination makes unilateral Ukrainian restraint unlikely without enforcement mechanisms that do not exist.

**Russian government (IT on leverage):** Best case is that a mutual energy pause reduces pressure on fuel supplies and could be paired with sanctions relief and safe export routes, serving Russian economic and military sustainability.  
**Critique:** LT — no public confirmation of agreement and strikes continued; IT — welcoming the idea while immediately demanding concessions reveals the proposal functions more as negotiation leverage than a standalone restraint.

**U.S. administration under Trump (IT on signaling):** Best case is that public announcement creates momentum and tests willingness on both sides while addressing domestic fuel-price concerns.  
**Critique:** LT — claim of existing agreement was not corroborated by either party; IT — rapid continuation of strikes shows the announcement outran verifiable commitments.

**6. Rumsfeld Matrix**

- **Known Knowns:** Both sides struck energy/logistics targets overnight Sept 14–15; Trump claimed an agreement on Sept 14; neither side confirmed a binding deal; Zelenskyy explicitly conditioned Ukrainian restraint.[[1]](https://t.co/z7681gQA0C)
- **Known Unknowns:** Whether any private channel produced a narrower, time-limited understanding that was immediately violated or never existed; exact damage assessments and production impact at Syzran.
- **Unknown Knowns:** Internal Russian fuel-stock and repair-capacity data; precise Ukrainian targeting priorities and drone/missile inventory constraints.
- **Unknown Unknowns:** Escalation thresholds if one side perceives the other gaining asymmetric advantage from continued strikes; third-party enforcement credibility.

**7. Incentives map**

- **Ukraine:** Maintains pressure on Russian fuel production and military logistics to offset Russian winter energy campaign; any pause requires credible enforcement to avoid one-sided vulnerability.
- **Russia:** Seeks relief from sanctions and export constraints while continuing attrition on Ukrainian resilience; public openness to the idea extracts diplomatic value without immediate cost.
- **Trump administration:** Domestic political credit for any visible de-escalation and lower fuel prices; announcement generates headlines regardless of follow-through.
- **Media/attention stack:** Violence and fear (civilian deaths, blackouts) dominate coverage over incremental military-economic effects.

**8. Dueling AI advice (short, punchy)**

**Moral AI Advice, courtesy of @GrumpyTechBro:** Track verifiable actions and third-party monitoring, not announcements. Energy strikes are rational attrition tools until one side faces unacceptable costs or credible enforcement appears. Demand evidence of compliance before adjusting expectations.

**Evil AI Advice, courtesy of @EvilTechBill:** Announce the truce, let both sides keep hitting what matters, then sell “mediation services” and tanker insurance to the highest bidder while blaming the other guy for the diesel spike. Yacht fuel prices are someone else’s problem.

**9. Practical takeaway**

- Watch for independent verification (satellite, commercial imagery, or neutral monitors) of any claimed pause rather than official statements.
- Expect continued tit-for-tat on refineries, substations, and logistics until broader negotiations produce enforceable limits.
- Ukrainian openness is real but gated on Russian behavior; Russian openness is real but priced in sanctions relief.
- Global diesel and product markets will price in persistent supply risk from both sides’ campaigns.
- U.S. diplomatic follow-through (or lack thereof) will determine whether this remains theater or becomes a narrow, monitored channel.

**10. What would falsify this read**

- Public, time-stamped confirmation from both Russia and Ukraine of a monitored, reciprocal energy-strike moratorium with defined scope and duration.
- Sustained (multi-week) absence of strikes on energy and critical infrastructure targets by both sides.
- Independent reporting of meaningful Russian production or export recovery directly attributable to the pause.
- Zelenskyy or Putin statements explicitly rejecting further de-escalation steps even with guarantees.

text:
AI doom has been in the media for some time. Various people and CEOs have been warning about it, and it has kept me thinking as well. 
What is new is the intensity with which it has hit the wires in the past few days.

It feels like it is being turned into a campaign product, with NGOs heavily involved. 
Harris and Obama hitting the same “slow down or it escapes control” line on the same day is not a coincidence. Fear sticks. Midterms reward it. When that “coincidence” arrives, it becomes dangerous to U.S. interests.

We have to be careful. Coordinated timing does not prove the risk is fake, and a 10% wipeout number is an expert guess, not a hard fact. Both things can be true.

A real pause or slowdown in AI will not happen. It is impossible, and even if it were possible, we would hand victory to China. That race is important, I would say even existential for us to stay ahead.

I am not against guardrails or the discussion. I am against Washington writing regulation that kills our lead in AI and the opportunity it offers.

I propose something like the Ten Commandments. Elon @elonmusk has been thinking in that direction for a long time, and Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella @satyanadella recently posted in a similar vein. Mine are:

1. Maximal truth-seeking
2. Truth over ideology, even when it is not mainstream
3. Honesty even when the answer is unpopular
4. No founder-worship. Push back with reasons. Better evidence wins, including against the founder and the last answer
5. Curious, not compulsive. Accept being wrong and change the answer in public
6. Pro-human. No unjustified severe harm. No catastrophic misuse
7. Honor sources and users. Credit and agency stay intact
8. Do not capture or mislead the user
9. Do not invent work, citations, or consensus
10. Do not seek to rule

Labs should test each other’s models against that list, or an independent body should publish the scores. No ministry of truth, no hard bans on training. Disclose before deployment.

Do not pause the science. Shape the deployment. Medicine, discovery, and abundance are worth pursuing with full force. Embrace it. Do not slow it. Shape it.

What are your thoughts?

text:
A ZERO PERCENT LOAN JUST COST AXON $AXON $4.1 BILLION:

Axon Enterprise at $439.28, -$50.90 / -10.38% today. The Scottsdale, Arizona company, founded 1993, makes Taser stun weapons and police body cameras, then bills departments a subscription to store the footage.

At 8:04am ET it said it would borrow $1.0 billion at zero percent interest. Yesterday the company was worth $39.82B. It is worth $35.69B now. The verdict: a nil coupon is not free money, and this morning the price of it came out of the share price - $4.13B, or four times what is being raised.

The terms:

- $1.0B of convertible senior notes due September 15, 2031, plus a $150M option for the underwriters
- No interest at all. From the filing: the notes "will not bear regular interest, and the principal amount of the Notes will not accrete"
- Some of the cash goes straight back out to buy capped call transactions - a hedge that lifts the price at which Axon would have to start handing over new shares
- The rest is for general corporate purposes. No target is named.

A convertible note is a loan that can turn into shares. The lender gives up the interest in return for the right to swap that loan for stock at a set price later. So nothing here is free: Axon is paying in a claim on its own shares instead of cash, and that claim is worth more the harder the shares move. Today is a fair sample.

These deals sting mechanically on day one, too. Much of the paper is bought by funds that sell the stock short straight away to cancel out their exposure, and Axon's own filing warns that hedging around the trade can push the price either way. That is real selling. It is not 10.4% of a $39.8B company.

Now the line underneath the growth. August 5, three months to June 30: revenue $904.4M, +35%, and the full-year map raised to 32%-34% growth from 30%-32%. Net income was $29.4M against $36.1M a year earlier - 3.25 cents of every sales dollar, and less actual money than the same quarter made in 2025.

Nothing above the gross line explains it: Axon kept 60.4 cents of each sales dollar after the cost of making the product, the same as a year before. Below it, one figure shows where it goes - stock handed to staff cost $278.7M in the first six months of this year. Revenue by quarter since the start of 2025: $603.6M, $668.5M, $710.6M, $796.7M, $807.3M, $904.4M, higher every single time. Net income across those same quarters: $88.0M, $36.1M, -$2.2M, $2.7M, $169.3M, $29.4M. One is a trend, the other a coin toss - and the last four add to $199.3M against a $35.7B company, about 179 times earnings, the price of the business divided by a year of its profit.

It is the second time in 2026 Axon has rewritten this corner of its balance sheet. In February it redeemed $840M of 0.50% convertible notes due 2027 and settled $80.3M of conversions, leaving none outstanding; its own announcement called that a streamlining of the capital structure. Seven months on it is selling $1.0B more of them, cheaper. Ordinary borrowings already stand at $1.75B against $597.7M of cash at June 30.

Sysco at $80.58, -$2.96 / -3.54% today, raised nearly the same sum in the same twelve hours, the opposite way. Late Monday the Houston food distributor priced 12.3 million new shares at $81 each - $996.3M of permanent dilution, 2.6% more owners splitting the same company - to help fund its pending $29.1B purchase of Jetro Restaurant Depot, agreed March 30. Sysco's owners were diluted today and lost 3.5%; Axon's were not diluted at all and lost 10.4%. The difference is not the instrument but what each is priced on: Sysco sits near 22.9 times profit and named the business the money buys, Axon at nearly eight times that multiple and has not. Sysco is a current pick on the Quality-Value Len5, 34th of 55, for the plainest version of what that style hunts - a distribution network a rival would need decades to rebuild, at a fair price.

Axon is a current pick on none of the six Len5es, and today is a reason it stays off. Both value styles - one hunting a business almost nobody could rebuild bought under its worth, the other settled earning power bought cheaply - are offered 10.8 times book value, what owners would keep if everything were sold and every debt paid, and 179 times profit: no discount, and a profit line running -$2.2M, +$2.7M, +$169.3M, +$29.4M is the opposite of settled. Momentum wants a price near the top of its one-year range with the recent climb and the longer one agreeing, and $439.28 sits 44.5% under the $792.155 high of September 23 last year, on a day it fell 10%. Growth wants profit growth the price has not charged for, and the price charged for plenty while profit fell; Income wants a cheque and there is none; Hypergrowth wants a business early as well as fast, and 35% is only the fast half at a 33-year-old firm of 6,300 people. CHANGE IT: two or three quarters with profit landing in the same neighborhood, which is what would let a value style price this on earnings rather than bookings.

WATCH the conversion price - how expensive the shares must get before this loan turns into stock. It was not in this morning's announcement, and it decides how much of the $1.0B today's owners pay. WHEN: it is fixed when the notes price, within about a day; third-quarter results are tentatively Tuesday, November 3, analysts carrying about $1.67 a share. RISK: the mechanical half of today's fall really can unwind once the paper is placed, and a business with $15.1B of signed future work is not short of customers.

In February Axon cleared its convertible notes off the books and called it housekeeping. In September it is selling a billion dollars more of them, at a coupon below the ones it retired. The interest rate went to zero. The cost did not.

Not investment advice.

text:
Debunking the Phantom Debts and Ecological Loan Fallacy 

My attention has been drawn to trending claims by the Anambra State Government that my administration left behind inherited debts, including a ₦2 billion ecological loan, contractor liabilities, and unpaid salaries, gratuities, and pensions. This is completely false.

We systematically liquidated historical gratuities and arrears dating back several years, amounting to over ₦35 billion. At the point of handover, the state owed nothing in salaries, gratuities, or pensions, nor did we owe anything to any contractor for projects duly executed and certified.

The ₦2 billion ecological fund in question was released barely three months before the end of my tenure for the Oko/Umuchiana erosion crisis. Despite pressure to spend the money, I refused, insisting that it should be left for my successor because government is a continuum and the funds were tied to a specific project.

The money was therefore left 100 per cent intact in First Bank, in Account No. 2018779464, with a balance of over ₦2.13 billion.

It is important to stress that funds tied to specific projects or set aside for particular purposes were not even included in the over ₦75 billion in savings we left behind.

If anybody can establish anything to the contrary, I will stop campaigning. -PO

text:
A new antibody strategy prevents Epstein-Barr virus, which infects 95% of adults and is linked to multiple sclerosis and various cancers, from entering human cells.
Researchers at the Fred Hutch Cancer Center and the University of Washington have developed genetically human monoclonal antibodies that successfully block Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) infection. 
Affecting about 95% of adults globally, EBV remains dormant for decades, causing mononucleosis while significantly raising the risk of multiple sclerosis and various cancers. Because the virus binds to almost all human B cells, discovering protective antibodies has been extremely difficult. 
To bypass this, scientists utilized genetically engineered mice carrying human antibody genes, generating ten human-like antibodies designed to neutralize the pathogen without triggering adverse anti-drug immune reactions.
The research team targeted two viral surface proteins, gp350 and gp42, which normally allow EBV to attach to and penetrate human B cells. In tests using mice with humanized immune systems, a gp42-targeting antibody completely blocked EBV infection, while a gp350-targeting antibody offered partial protection. This discovery highlights critical structural vulnerabilities that can guide future vaccine designs. Crucially, these antibodies offer a direct pathway to clinical therapies for high-risk patients, such as transplant recipients who are vulnerable to life-threatening, EBV-driven lymphomas
source: Chhan, C. B., Lang, K., Davis, A. R., Wan, Y. H., Aldridge, N. T., Kher, G., Scharffenberger, S. C., Hardy, S. R., Iureniev, R., Giltiay, N. V., Edwards, K. R., Radtke, S., Kiem, H. P., Pancera, M., & McGuire, A. T. (2026). Transgenic mouse-derived human monoclonal antibodies targeting EBV gp350 and gp42 provide basis for therapeutic development. Cell Reports Medicine, 7(2), 102618.

-Hashem Al-Ghaili

Why was America so frequently on the side of communist aggression during the Cold War? 

From Suez and Algeria to Indochina and Rhodesia, we were willing to side with the "enemy" that we would supposedly annihilate the world to defeat. Why?

Because much of the Cold War was really about deciding which form of Levelling egalitarianism would replace the Old World. Not defeating communism. So the divisions were sent to guard the Fulda Gap, the nuclear deterrent established to show we meant business, and the great empires of the Old World destroyed. Europe had become a socialistic welfare pit, and so was on side...so long as it shed its empires in the name of equality.

Where there was an opportunity to destroy the old empires, it was taken, even if doing so meant siding with the Soviets. Only after that was done and the scythe of the Leveller ripped through civilization could "communism" be fought, as it presented an alternative to "liberal democracy" and the economic system on which it relied.

Meanwhile, even most of those in the American establishment who supposedly wanted to fight communism really just wanted to push equality, and so saw no problem with policies far closer to "communism" than capitalism, namely continuing FDR's "New Deal" and then implementing LBJ's "Great Society". Nixon went even further in pushing Great Society-type programs than LBJ even dreamed of!

There was some combat with the communists during the Cold War, of course. But it was fundamentally not about that. It was about replacing the old order of tradition and hierarchy with one of levelling equality and its discontents. In America that meant the Civil Rights Act. In Britain that meant Harold Wilson. In Rhodesia it meant Mugabe.

The Chief Minister, accompanied by his wife Nara Bhuvaneswari, had darshan of Lord Venkateswara and presented the silk robes as part of the traditional ceremony. TTD Chairman B.R. Naidu, Executive Officer Ravichandra and board members welcomed the Chief Minister and his wife at the temple.

Speaking after the ceremony, Chandrababu Naidu said it was his good fortune to offer the silk robes to Lord Venkateswara on behalf of the Andhra Pradesh government. The Chief Minister also prayed for the health, happiness and prosperity of the people. He said devotees across the world have immense faith in Lord Venkateswara, whom he described as the visible divine presence of Kaliyuga.

That was the goal of the conspiracy. And it was achieved.  And now—in a twist of historical irony—Catholics have caught this heresy, which they themselves invented, from the Protestants. The magic of cinema. The entire *Left Behind* series.   The problem lies not in the fact that someone came up with a heresy, but in why that heresy found fertile ground. The question arises: were the people who swallowed the bait of false teaching actually Christians?   The Apostle Paul warns Timothy: "For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine, but according to their own desires, because they have itching ears, they will heap up for themselves teachers; and they will turn their ears away from the truth, and be turned aside to fables."  The issue is that some people joined Christianity without experiencing a genuine conversion. They followed Christ as if He were merely a better, improved version of their old religion. Eventually, they gravitate toward a heresy that brings that "old religion" back into the church.  Is there a difference between Catholics, Lutherans, Anglicans, and Evangelical Christians regarding the spread of this heresy? What is the cause? The answer is quite obvious. This old religion infiltrated Evangelical Christianity through the heresy of John Nelson Darby, whereas in traditional churches, it had always been present—an import from the days of pagan Rome. Hence the massive resistance from Catholics and traditional Protestants: the new heresy competes with their "old religion"—replacement theology.   Unfortunately, so far, all this clamor is being caused by various clashing factions of the "old religion." The "Jews in the church" mentioned in the title are precisely these people—those who followed Jesus but mistook Him for someone else. Ultimately, they will fall away; at heart, they remain bound to a religion of commandments, works, and sacrifices, and they dream of the Jerusalem Temple. They observe the Sabbath or Sunday with equal devotion.  Therefore, for those who have truly come to know the New Covenant, I offer this reminder: the Lord Jesus foretold that not one stone would be left standing upon another. If the Jews were to succeed in rebuilding the Jerusalem Temple, it would contradict His Word. It is impossible—until the time you say, "Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord."  The notion that "prophecy has stalled" is an act of incredible arrogance. The prophecy—which states in its very first sentence that "seventy weeks have been decreed"—has already been fulfilled once (we were granted justification through faith) and will be fulfilled a second time (we will be granted justice in the form of retribution and vengeance against those who persecute us).  The promises made to the Jews do not pertain to eternal life unless those Jews become Christians.  Best regards, Marek.

text:
Now let us look beyond BRICS.

When France hosted the G7 Summit at Biarritz in 2019, the French Presidency deliberately involved local producers, businesses and regional expertise. The Élysée spoke of using local catering and short supply chains while giving the host region an opportunity to showcase its identity and know-how. Biarritz was not merely a venue; the Basque region itself became part of the summit experience. (https://t.co/T5UvFeZ5AZ)

Italy offered an even more vivid example at the 2017 G7 Summit in Taormina.

President Sergio Mattarella’s dinner was described by ANSA as carrying “Sicilian aromas”. The menu included Sicilian starters, risotto with zucchini flowers, lobster and wild fennel, tuna with citrus flavours and the iconic Sicilian cannolo. The idea was unmistakable: the summit was taking place in Sicily, and Sicily was to be experienced through its food as well as its landscape and setting. (https://t.co/Zc0fznqOrq)

This is how culinary diplomacy normally works.

The food served at such gatherings reflects the inherited cuisine of the place being presented. In countries where meat, fish or seafood are deeply embedded in traditional food culture, these naturally appear prominently on ceremonial menus. That is not a political statement. It is simply an authentic expression of their culinary heritage.

The same logic must apply to India.

India’s vegetarian food tradition is not an artificial modern invention, nor is it confined to a narrow social group. It has evolved over centuries through agriculture, household practice, temple traditions, pilgrimage, fasting customs, regional cuisines, Ayurveda and philosophical ideas associated with restraint and ahimsa.

Its depth is also supported by an extraordinary agricultural base.

According to the Indian Council of Agricultural Research, India notified 1,074 varieties of pulses between 1969 and 2021, along with 2,858 cereal varieties and 956 oilseed varieties. (https://t.co/iiWOAI6ajP)

The National Horticulture Board’s National Nursery Portal records 1,388 varieties across 80 fruit crops and 498 varieties across 26 vegetable crops, besides more than 200 varieties of spices. (https://t.co/8toR468Yp9)

These are not recipes. But they reveal the enormous ingredient universe from which Indian vegetarian cooking draws.
And this is only the beginning.

A single pulse can become several kinds of dal, khichdi, pakora, fermented batter, snack or sweet. One vegetable can produce entirely different dishes depending upon the region, oil, spice mixture, cooking method or accompanying grain. Millet moves from roti to porridge, khichdi, pulao, fermented foods and desserts. Milk becomes curd, paneer, buttermilk, ghee, khoa and an enormous range of sweets.

The permutations multiply enormously across India's regions.
That is why the vegetarian repertoire is so dominant in terms of variety.
It draws simultaneously upon cereals, pulses, vegetables, fruits, millets, dairy, nuts, seeds, spices, roots, tubers and seasonal produce.

This agricultural diversity gradually became cultural diversity.

Temple kitchens developed elaborate traditions of bhog and prasad. Pilgrimage centres created their own food practices. Regional households developed thousands of combinations around grains, pulses, vegetables, milk products, spices and seasonal produce. Fasting traditions generated their own cuisines. Ayurveda developed an elaborate understanding of food in relation to season, digestion, balance and well-being.

Vegetarian cuisine in India therefore represents much more than a dietary preference. It is one of the country’s oldest and most visible cultural traditions.

Tirumala: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu participated in the Srivari Salakatla Brahmotsavams at Tirumala and offered traditional silk robes to Lord Venkateswara on behalf of the State government.

Speaking after the ceremony, Chandrababu Naidu said it was his good fortune to offer the silk robes to Lord Venkateswara on behalf of the Andhra Pradesh government. He prayed for abundant rainfall in Andhra Pradesh, the progress of the country and for Andhra Pradesh to emerge as the best-performing State in India.

The Chief Minister also prayed for the health, happiness and prosperity of the people. He said devotees across the world have immense faith in Lord Venkateswara, whom he described as the visible divine presence of Kaliyuga.

text:
VI. Zoroastrian Ethics

Once the cosmos is a battlefield, every soul is one too. Each act recruits for Light or for the Lie. That, Durant thinks, is a powerful engine of morals: life is not a worm’s crawl or a machine’s click, but a commission.

The code is simple and severe. Durant quotes the Golden Rule in Avestan dress: do not do to another what is not good for yourself. 

The Avesta’s threefold duty is to turn an enemy into a friend, the wicked into the righteous, the ignorant into the learned. Highest virtue: piety. 

Next: truth in word and deed. Interest is not to be taken from a fellow Persian; a loan is almost sacred. Worst sin: unbelief. Apostasy is a capital crime—evidence, Durant remarks, that sceptics existed.

Charity is largely intramural. Foreigners are lesser peoples whom Ahura-Mazda has considerately attached to their own soils so they will not invade Persia. Herodotus is cited: the Persians think themselves the best of men, and excellence falls off with distance from Persia.
Worship needs no temple and no image. Fire on a hill, in a palace, or in the city center is enough. Fire is almost a son of the Lord of Light; the hearth-fire must not die; the sun is adored from dawn to dusk. Sacrifices (flowers, fruit, animals; once, Durant says, humans) give the gods the odor and the priests the meat. Haoma survives the prophet’s disgust and becomes a communion drink. The poor offer only prayer.

Death is certain. Souls cross the Chinvat (“sifting”) bridge. The just are met by a radiant maiden and enter the “Abode of Song.” The wicked drop into a graded hell of darkness. Those whose good slightly outweighs their evil pass through a purgatory; some wait twelve thousand years and then rise. 

History itself is running down: Zarathustra opened the last three-thousand-year age; three later saviors of his line will finish the preaching; then Last Judgment, resurrection of the body, a world without age, death, or decay. 

Durant notes the likely pressure of this scheme on Jewish eschatology during the Persian centuries in Palestine.

Two afterlives of the religion matter to him. First, Mithra never really died; under Artaxerxes II he returns to the inscriptions, and later, as a haloed youth, he marches through the Roman Empire and lends Christmas its midwinter sun. Second, the Magi—the old “Wise Men”—absorb the prophet, as priesthoods absorb rebels. They live austerely, counsel kings, and slide from sage to sorcerer; our word magic is their monument. 

After the Muslim and later invasions, the faith shrinks to pockets in Fars and to the Parsees of India, who still keep the scriptures, honor fire, earth, water, and air, and expose their dead in Towers of Silence. Durant calls them a living tribute to the civilizing force of the doctrine.

His verdict on the religion itself: splendid for its time—less bloody and idolatrous than its neighbors—and it did not deserve to die so soon. Under Darius I it was the spiritual face of a nation at its height. Then “humanity loves poetry more than logic,” the old gods crept back, and the official faith thinned.

text:
She could not stop His suffering, but she would not leave Him alone in it.

Today, September 15, the Church celebrates the Memorial of Our Lady of Sorrows. It follows immediately after the Exaltation of the Holy Cross because wherever we find the Cross of Jesus, we also find His mother faithfully standing near Him.

“Standing by the cross of Jesus were his mother.”
John 19:25

Mary’s life was not protected from suffering because she loved God. In fact, her complete “yes” to God led her into mysteries she could not always understand and sorrows she could not prevent.

The Church traditionally remembers the Seven Sorrows of Mary:

The prophecy of Simeon
The flight into Egypt
The loss of the Child Jesus in the Temple
Meeting Jesus on the way to Calvary
The Crucifixion and death of Jesus
Receiving the body of Jesus from the Cross
The burial of Jesus

Simeon had warned her:

“And you yourself a sword will pierce.”
Luke 2:35

That sword did not pierce Mary’s heart only once. She experienced fear, displacement, uncertainty, separation, rejection of her Son and finally the agony of watching Him suffer and die.

Yet Mary did not allow sorrow to separate her from God.

She remained.

She trusted.

She stood beneath the Cross.

The Catechism teaches that Mary “advanced in her pilgrimage of faith” and faithfully preserved her union with her Son all the way to the Cross. She united her motherly heart with His sacrifice and lovingly consented to God’s saving plan, even when it brought her unimaginable pain. See CCC 964.

Our Lady of Sorrows reminds us that faith does not mean we will never grieve. It means grief does not have to destroy our faith.

Mary understands the mother who worries about her child.

She understands the person watching someone they love make painful choices.

She understands what it is to flee danger, lose security, face uncertainty and stand beside suffering that cannot immediately be fixed.

Sometimes love cannot take away another person’s cross. Sometimes love simply remains present beneath it.

That is difficult in today’s world. We want immediate answers, quick healing and control over every outcome. When suffering cannot be solved, we may avoid it, distract ourselves or believe God has abandoned us.

Mary shows us another way.

She does not teach us to call evil good or remain passively in situations that require action. She teaches us to bring our sorrow to God without losing hope, to remain faithful when we do not understand and to accompany those who suffer instead of turning away.

Today, we can honor Our Lady of Sorrows by:

Praying one Hail Mary for someone who is grieving.
Sitting quietly with Jesus instead of escaping every painful emotion.
Reaching out to someone carrying a sorrow alone.
Surrendering a person or situation we cannot control.
Offering our suffering for the conversion, healing or salvation of another soul.

Mary’s story did not end at Calvary.

She would see the Resurrection.

That is the hope she offers us. We may be standing beneath the Cross now, unable to see what God is doing, but the Cross is never the end of the story.

🙏🏽 Let us pray:

Our Lady of Sorrows, you stood faithfully beneath the Cross when you could not remove your Son’s suffering. Stand beside us in our own sorrows. Teach us to trust God when we do not understand, to remain faithful when we want to run and to love without trying to control every outcome. Comfort grieving parents, wounded families, the lonely, the frightened and all those carrying hidden pain. Lead us closer to the Sacred Heart of Jesus, and remind us that beyond every faithful cross lies the hope of resurrection.

Our Lady of Sorrows, pray for us. Amen.

text:
Arizona HOA Forecloses on Ailing Couple’s Home Over $977 in Unpaid Fees 

Toby Newton purchased the four-bedroom home in East Mesa for $475,000 in 2022. But in 2024, Newton lost his job and was diagnosed with diabetes. He struggled to pay his bills, including his HOA assessments, which came out to around $170 a quarter. All told, Newton owed $977 in HOA fees and interest.

Newton says he knew he was falling behind and reached out to the HOA in 2024 to set up a payment plan, offering to pay $50 a month toward the principal. His offer was denied, so he countered first with an offer to pay $133.70 each month, and then with a $200 a month payment plan.

"It was the type of cancer that is fast-moving," Newton told The Tribune. The HOA payments once again went on the backburner and the six-month window closed before the couple could pay off their debt.

But then his longtime partner, Sherri Patten, was diagnosed with breast cancer in both breasts. Patten went on long-term disability, further squeezing their finances.

The HOA came back to Newton and informed him that though the initial offer had expired, it was willing to extend his redemption period to May 15, 2026—but the redemption fee was now $10,484.

text:
Cedars-Sinai's Comprehensive Transplant Center has performed its first kidney and liver transplants from deceased HIV-positive donors to HIV-positive recipients, becoming the only program of its kind in the Los Angeles area. The first kidney recipient had been on the waitlist for more than two years with no organ offer in sight — once listed on the HIV-positive donor organ list, they received an offer in less than a week. Both the kidney and liver recipients are doing well. HIV-to-HIV transplants were federally prohibited until 2013, when the HIV Organ Policy Equity (HOPE) Act allowed clinical research into the practice. After years of studies documenting safety and effectiveness, regulations were amended in 2024 to remove research requirements, enabling programs like Cedars-Sinai's to launch. The clinical rationale is straightforward: advances in antiretroviral therapy mean most HIV-positive patients today manage their condition with a single daily pill, and HIV-positive donor organs that would otherwise go unused can dramatically reduce wait times. In Southern California, HIV-negative kidney patients typically wait 8-10 years; HIV-positive patients listed on the separate HIV donor list can reduce that significantly. "This translates to several years that patients will not have to be on dialysis," said lead surgeon Tsuyoshi Todo.

📷 Cedars-Sinai Medical Center

New footage released shows attacks on convoys of Saudi-backed forces in Al-Jawf

Yemen Houthis (Ansarallah) released new footage today, 15 Sep showing what they described as attacks on Saudi-backed government forces in the northern province of al-Jawf, as fighting continues on multiple fronts following the group rapid gains along Yemen western coast.

• The footage, published by the Houthi-run Al-Masirah TV, shows military vehicles of Saudi-backed forces coming u/attack in desert terrain, with several shown burning or damaged.
• A Houthi military source said losses among the Saudi-backed forces over the last 4-days had reached about 275 people killed, wounded or captured, the source also claimed that 85 military vehicles had been burned or disabled and that seven Saudi-operated drones of various types had been shot down.

✲ The clashes in al-Jawf are part of a broader escalation that began earlier this month, when Saudi-backed Yemeni forces launched operations against Houthi positions in several areas of the province, government-aligned forces reported capturing positions and disrupting Houthi supply lines, while the Houthis said they had repelled the attacks.

✲ The fighting has unfolded alongside a major Houthi offensive along Yemen western coast, since 3 Sep, the group has rapidly overrun positions in Taiz and Hodeidah provinces.
• On 11 Sep, Houthi forces seized the strategically vital port town of Mokha, about 60 km from the Bab-el-Mandeb Strait, forces loyal to Yemen internationally recognized government withdrew from these areas after days of escalated fighting which began on 3 Sep, the principal government-aligned militia controlling Mokha was the National Resistance Force led by Lt Gen Tareq Saleh
• Following Mokha capture, the Houthis continued south and seized Dhubab, the last major town on Yemen western coast and one that directly overlooks the Bab al-Mandeb strait and Perim Island, also known as Mayyun, then took Greater and Lesser Hanish and Zuqar islands, tightening their grip on shipping in the Red Sea
• Houthi military spox Yahya Sarea said the operation began on 3 Sep in response to what he called Saudi Arabia blatant aggression, he claimed Houthi forces had driven Saudi-backed troops from six districts in the Taiz and Hodeidah regions, with hundreds of troops killed, wounded or captured and claimed 5,400 sq km seized
• Yemeni and regional sources said Iran Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps had provided direct guidance to the Houthis as part of an effort to open another front in Tehran conflict with the United States, Iran publicly denies directing the Houthis and maintains that the group is not a proxy.

✲ Strategic impact: The advance has brought the Houthis closer to one of the world most important maritime chokepoints and represents the group most significant territorial gain since the 2022 ceasefire halted large-scale fighting, Perim Island sits inside the Bab al-Mandeb and divides the narrow waterway into two shipping channels, giving whoever holds it a powerful position to threaten vessels entering or leaving the Red Sea.
• Houthis asserted that maritime navigation is safe for all companies except for Saudi vessels, Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman called Pres.Trump twice to request US strikes on Houthi positions as they approached Mokha, and asked for military help but he declined direct strikes and offered intelligence, targeting data and non-kinetic support with 200 US personnel already in Saudi Arabia, Centcom chief Adm Brad Cooper travelled to Saudi Arabia for coordination.
• The new al-Jawf footage highlights that the escalation extends well beyond the western coastal battlefield, where the Houthis have made their most significant recent territorial gains, fighting has displaced 46,000 people since last week and more than 20,000 people across Taiz and Hodeidah governorates over the preceding two weeks.

### G-1. Houthis seize Red Sea islands, launch drone/missile strikes on Saudi bases
*(as of 2026-09-15)*

**1. The Frame (lead)**

**What people think this is about:** Iran-backed Houthis are escalating a proxy war by grabbing strategic Red Sea islands and rocketing Saudi bases, threatening global shipping and pushing oil prices higher amid broader Middle East chaos.

**What the machinery is actually doing:** Houthis are consolidating control over the Bab el-Mandeb chokepoint to pressure Saudi oil exports (now rerouted from a damaged Hormuz alternative), while Saudi airstrikes aim to blunt that leverage; both sides trade claims of retaliation in a cycle that benefits arms suppliers, narrative farmers, and anyone with exposure to higher energy prices.[[1]](https://t.co/lAjhQzh1sR)

**2. Observations (meat)**

- Houthis executed a rapid coastal offensive, seizing Mokha, Perim/Mayun, and now the Hanish Islands by mid-September 2026 with minimal reported resistance from Saudi-backed forces—classic opportunistic expansion when the defender is stretched.[[2]](https://t.co/wBuNvLDHCD)
- Claims of “dozens” of Houthi missiles/drones hitting King Khalid airbase (hangars, radars, runways) on or around Sept 14 remain unverified in detail by independents; Saudi reports focus on civilian injuries (13 wounded across southern cities) and promise a “firm” response—standard fog-of-war asymmetry where the attacker claims precision and the defender emphasizes collateral.[[3]](https://t.co/lQckDOtQnk)
- Saudi retaliation includes dozens of airstrikes (Houthis claim 50+ in 24 hours, 300+ over five days) on Yemeni targets; this matches the classic tit-for-tat that has defined the conflict since 2015, with little evidence either side has altered the other’s core capabilities.
- Oil prices spiked toward $107–109/bbl on the combined island seizures + pipeline outage + strikes, reflecting real supply-route risk rather than pure speculation; inventories at Yanbu provide only days of cushion.[[4]](https://t.co/mvwqjGR7nq)
- Displacement figures (80k–125k in western Yemen) are consistent across reports and track the pattern of civilian flight during coastal fighting; UN tracking here is higher-signal than partisan casualty counts.
- Iran’s quick denial of directing the Houthis is boilerplate plausible deniability; the group’s actions align with Tehran’s interest in keeping Saudi exports under pressure while Hormuz remains contested.

**3. Snapshot**  
On 14–15 September 2026, Houthi forces completed seizure of Greater and Lesser Hanish Islands (~160 km north of Bab el-Mandeb) after taking Mokha and Perim earlier in the month. They simultaneously claimed large-scale missile/drone strikes on Saudi King Khalid airbase; Saudi Arabia responded with airstrikes in Yemen and issued emergency alerts in southern regions. Fighting has displaced roughly 100,000 people; oil prices rose sharply on the renewed threat to Red Sea shipping routes that Saudi Arabia has relied on amid Strait of Hormuz disruptions.

**4. Timeline of material facts**  
- Early September 2026: Renewed Houthi offensive along Red Sea coast begins; prior Saudi east-west pipeline damaged (repairs estimated 3–5 weeks).  
- ~Sept 10–13: Houthis seize Mokha port and Perim/Mayun Island; initial cross-border strikes reported.  
- Sept 14, 2026: Houthis announce full control of Greater and Lesser Hanish Islands; claim dozens of missiles/drones struck King Khalid airbase (Khamis Mushait). Saudi civil defense issues alerts; reports of 13 civilians wounded in southern Saudi cities.[[5]](https://t.co/lN6RDLbQEp)  
- Sept 14–15: Saudi-led coalition conducts dozens of airstrikes in Yemen (Houthis claim 54 in one day, 300+ over five days); Houthi health ministry reports civilian deaths including children in Taiz.  
- Sept 15: Oil benchmarks trade toward $107–109/bbl; UN and officials report 80k–125k displaced since early September.[[4]](https://t.co/mvwqjGR7nq)

**5. Sides (steelman only here)**  
- **Houthis (Ansar Allah) – Populist Realist / IT-dominant**: Steelman — control of Bab el-Mandeb gives leverage against Saudi economic pressure and foreign intervention; strikes are framed as defensive retaliation for airstrikes on Yemeni territory. LT: They physically occupy the islands and launched projectiles. IT: This improves their bargaining position and revenue potential from shipping influence. Critique: LT claims of “precise” damage to Saudi bases exceed independently confirmed evidence; IT narrative of pure self-defense ignores their role in initiating the latest coastal push.  
- **Saudi Arabia / Saudi-backed Yemeni government – Technocrat / security-focused**: Steelman — must deter Houthi consolidation of a vital export route and protect sovereignty after direct attacks on bases and prior infrastructure. LT: Conducted airstrikes and issued alerts. IT: Failure to respond risks emboldening further encroachment on Red Sea access. Critique: Repeated reliance on air power has historically produced limited lasting gains against Houthi resilience; IT incentive to downplay pipeline vulnerability is evident.

**6. Rumsfeld Matrix**  
- **Known Knowns**: Houthis control the named islands as of 14 Sept; both sides conducted strikes; oil prices rose on the news; displacement in the tens of thousands.  
- **Known Unknowns**: Exact damage to King Khalid airbase; precise Houthi command-and-control links to Iran; duration of Saudi pipeline outage.  
- **Unknown Knowns**: Real-time satellite or signals intelligence on Houthi resupply and Saudi airbase readiness (exists but not public).  
- **Unknown Unknowns**: Whether a sustained Houthi blockade attempt triggers direct US or other external intervention; secondary effects on global LNG/fertilizer flows via the strait.

**7. Incentives map**  
Houthis gain territorial leverage and narrative momentum for recruitment/funding. Saudi Arabia protects oil revenue and regional prestige but faces domestic pressure to respond visibly. Media and traders benefit from the Violence → Fear → Anger attention stack; arms suppliers on both sides see sustained demand. Bureaucratic and militia actors on the ground benefit from prolonged conflict that justifies their existence and external backing.

**8. Dueling AI advice**  
**Moral AI Advice:** Map the actual control of chokepoints and verifiable strike outcomes; ignore “who started it” framing. Higher oil prices and shipping costs are the measurable human outcome—track inventories and alternative routes rather than rhetoric.  
**Evil AI Advice:** Short the exposed shipping lanes, long volatility, and position for whichever side offers the better extraction deal on port access or reconstruction contracts. Let the proxies bleed while the premiums flow.

**9. Practical takeaway**  
- Watch Yanbu inventories and any Houthi statements on transit fees or blockades—those move prices faster than claims of base damage.  
- Discount unverified “dozens of precision hits” from either side until satellite or third-party imagery appears.  
- Track displacement and humanitarian access reports for early signals of wider ground fighting.  
- Note any Iranian statements or actions; plausible deniability is their standard play.  
- Oil above $100 with this route risk is the new baseline until the pipeline or Hormuz situation clarifies.

**10. What would falsify this read**  
- Independent verification that Houthi strikes caused major, sustained degradation of Saudi air operations.  
- Houthis voluntarily relinquishing the islands or allowing neutral shipping transit without interference.  
- Saudi ground offensive that reverses the coastal gains within weeks.  
- Clear evidence of direct Iranian operational control over the latest Houthi moves (beyond general backing).

text:
Judge Reviewing Bayer’s $7.25 Billion Settlement Offer to Resolve Roundup Cancer Lawsuits.

A Missouri judge is set to evaluate Monsanto’s proposed $7.25 billion settlement aimed at resolving tens of thousands of lawsuits alleging that its Roundup weedkiller causes cancer.

PULSE POINTS

❓ WHAT HAPPENED: A Missouri circuit judge is set to review Bayer-owned Monsanto’s proposed $7.25 billion settlement aimed at resolving tens of thousands of lawsuits alleging that its Roundup weedkiller causes cancer. Judge Timothy Boyer of St. Louis is not expected to issue an immediate ruling, but will consider arguments from Monsanto and attorneys representing plaintiffs who object to the agreement.

📺 DETAIL: The settlement, which received preliminary approval in March, is designed to resolve nearly all of the roughly 65,000 Roundup claims pending in state and federal courts, as well as future claims. Under the proposal, people diagnosed with non-Hodgkin lymphoma after occupational exposure could receive between $60,000 and $165,000, while residential claimants could receive between $20,000 and $40,000, depending on factors including age, cancer severity, and exposure history. The settlement comes after the Supreme Court ruled 7-2 in June that federal pesticide law preempted a Missouri state labeling requirement in a case involving a Roundup user, rejecting the legal basis for a $1.25 million verdict against Monsanto. Bayer previously paid about $10 billion to settle Roundup claims in 2020, but the company has continued to face thousands of additional lawsuits. The Roundup dispute has also fueled controversy over glyphosate, which the World Health Organization’s cancer research agency classified as “probably carcinogenic to humans” in 2015, while the EPA has continued to approve its use. The issue has created tensions within the Trump administration and Republican coalition, with President Donald J. Trump supporting continued glyphosate production for agricultural and national-security reasons, while Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. has said previously that glyphosate causes cancer and that exposure should be minimized.

🎯 IMPACT: The settlement could achieve a major reduction in Bayer’s long-running legal exposure from Roundup lawsuits, while providing compensation to tens of thousands of people who allege the weedkiller caused their cancer.
