I bless thee Tom in the Name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit! Amen!
Heavenly Father, I lift this beloved one into Your loving hands, asking that Your healing touch restore his body completely. Remove all heart problems, leukemia, cancer, disease, infirmary, injury, sickness, fatigue, or pain, and renew his strength, energy, and vitality. Grant wisdom and skill to the medical team, patience to this beloved one, and peace to his heart. Surround him with Your divine protection, and let Your presence comfort and reassure him. May Your grace and mercy flow through every part of   TOM’s being. In Jesus’ name I beg and pray, Amen.

Prayer to the Holy Spirit:
Come, Holy Spirit, Divine Comforter and Breath of Life. Enter all places of heart problems, cancer, tumors, pain, injury, disease, infection, suffering, weakness and fear. Remove every and all infirmary, and surround   TOMwith Your gentle light, while completely healing   TOM while filling his heart with the strength and peace that comes from above, trusting to the power of God’s eternal love. Amen.

Pray to the Blessed Holy Mother Mary:

Dear Mother Mary, With hearts heavy and bodies burdened, we approach your divine presence, seeking your miraculous touch. Your healing power knows no equal, and in our times of need, we implore you to mend not only our physical wounds but the scars that mar our souls. Pour forth your divine grace upon us, dear Mother, and restore us to a state of wholeness, that we may bear witness to the miracle of your love. Amen.

Prayer to St. Jude:

Oh glorious apostle St. Jude, faithful servant and friend of Jesus, the name of the traitor who delivered thy beloved Master into the hands of His enemies has caused thee to be forgotten by many, but the Church honors and invokes thee universally as the patron of hopeless cases--of things despaired of. Pray for me who am so miserable; make use, I implore thee, of that particular privilege accorded thee of bringing visible and speedy help where help is almost despaired of. Come to my assistance in this great need, that I may receive the consolations and succor of heaven in all my necessities, tribulations and sufferings, particularly—completely heal from all heart problems, injuries, cancer and diseases, and protect   TOM —and that I may bless God with thee and all the elect throughout eternity. I promise thee, O blessed St. Jude, to be ever mindful of this great favor, and I will never cease to honor thee as my special and powerful patron, and to do all in my power to encourage devotion to thee. Amen

O Glorious Prince of the heavenly host, Saint Michael the Archangel, defend us in the battle and fearful warfare that we are waging against the principalities and powers, against the rulers of this world of darkness, against the evil spirits. Come thou to the assistance of men, whom Almighty God created immortal, making them in His own image and likeness and redeeming them at a great price from the tyranny of Satan. Fight this day the battle of the Lord with thy le  TOMns of holy Angels, even as of old thou didst fight against Lucifer, the leader of the proud spirits and all his rebel angels, who were powerless to stand against thee, neither was their place found any more in heaven. And that great dragon was cast forth, the ancient serpent, who is called the devil and satan, who seduces the whole world; and he was cast forth upon Earth, and his angels were sent with him.

But behold! the ancient enemy of mankind and a murderer from the beginning has been fiercely aroused. Changing himself into an angel of light, he goes about with the whole multitude of the wicked spirits to invade the earth and blot out the Name of God and of His Christ, to plunder, to slay, and to consign to eternal damnation the souls that have been destined for a crown of everlasting life. This wicked serpent, like an unclean torrent, pours into men of depraved minds and corrupt hearts the poison of his malice, the spirit of lying, impiety and blasphemy, and the deadly breath of impurity and every form of vice and iniquity.

Be favorable to Thy Church, the Bride of the Lamb without spot, whose enemies have filled to overflowing with gall and inebriated with wormwood. They have laid profane hands upon Her most sacred treasures. Where the See of the most blessed Peter and the Chair of Truth has been constituted as a light to the nations, there they have placed a throne of their abomination and impiety; so that with the Pastor struck, they may prevail to disperse the flock.

Therefore, most invincible Leader, be with the people of God against this spiritual wickedness and bring about victory. Thou art venerated by Holy Church as Her guard and patron; Thou art glorified as our defender against the impious powers of earth and of hell. Unto thee the Lord hath handed over the souls of the redeemed to be placed in happiness above.

Entreat the God of peace, to obliterate satan beneath our feet, lest he prevail further to hold men captive, and to injure the Church. Offer our prayers in the sight of the Most High, so that the mercy of the Lord may swiftly overtake us, and apprehend the dragon, the ancient serpent, who is the devil and satan, and send him bound into the abyss, so that he may seduce the nations no more.

Henceforth having been confided to thy escort and protection, we sacred ministers by the authority of the Holy Mother Church [if recited by a cleric of the order of exorcist or above, say instead: by our authority], do undertake to repel the infestations of diabolical deceit in the Name of Jesus Christ, Our God and Lord.

Behold the Cross of the Lord; be scattered hostile powers.
The Lion of the tribe of Juda has conquered, the root of David.
Let Thy mercies be upon us, O Lord.
As we have hoped in Thee.
O Lord, hear my prayer.
And let my cry come unto Thee.
The Lord be with you all.
And with thy spirit.

Let us pray.
O God, and Father of Our Lord Jesus Christ, we invoke Thy Holy Name, and we humbly implore Thy clemency so that, through the intercession of Mary, the Immaculate ever-Virgin Mother of God, of blessed Michael the Archangel, of blessed Joseph, the Spouse of the same blessed Virgin, of the blessed Apostles Peter and Paul, and of all the Saints, Thou may deign to offer us aid against satan, and all the other unclean spirits, who wander through the world to injure the human race and to destroy souls. We ask this through Christ Our Lord. Amen.

Prayer for possible any evil influence:

In His Name and by the power of His Cross and Blood, I ask Jesus Christ to bind any evil spirits, forces and powers of the earth, air, fire, water, and of the netherworld and all of the satanic forces of nature. By the power of the Holy Spirit and by His authority, I ask Jesus Christ to break any and all curses, hexes, vexes, jinks, spells, and all wrong prayers and words, and to send them all back to where they came from, if it be His Holy Will. I beseech Thee, Lord Jesus Christ, to protect us by pouring Thy Precious Blood on us; myself, my family, my friends, and all those I pray and intercede for; which Thou hast shed for us and I ask Thee to command that any departing spirits leave quietly, without disturbance, and go straight to Thy Cross to be disposed of as Thou sees fit. I ask Thee to bind any demonic interactions, interplay, or communications. I place myself, my family, my friends, and all those I pray and intercede for, and all things I pray and intercede for under the protection of the Blood of Jesus Christ which He has shed for us. Amen.

Heavenly Father, I lift this beloved one into Your loving hands, asking that Your healing touch restore her body completely. Remove all burn injuries, heart problems, pulmonary embolisms, tumors, leukemia, cancer, disease, infirmary, injury of any sort, sickness, fatigue, or pain, and renew her strength, energy, and Grant wisdom and skill to the medical team, patience to this beloved one, and peace to her heart. Surround her with Your divine protection, and let Your presence comfort and reassure her. May Your grace and mercy flow through every part of   SOPHIA’sbeing. In Jesus’ name I beg and pray, Amen.

Prayer to the Holy Spirit:
Come, Holy Spirit, Divine Comforter and Breath of Life. Enter all places of burn injuries, heart problems, pulmonary embolisms,cancer, tumors, pain, injury, disease, infection, suffering, weakness and fear. Remove every and all infirmary, burn injuries, and surround   SOPHIA with Your gentle light, while completely healing   SOPHIA while filling her heart with the strength and peace that comes from above, trusting to the power of God’s eternal love. Pray to the Blessed Holy Mother Mary:

Dear Mother Mary, With hearts heavy and bodies burdened, we approach your divine presence, seeking your miraculous touch. Your healing power knows no equal, and in our times of need, we implore you to mend not only our physical wounds but the scars that mar our souls. Pour forth your divine grace upon us, dear Mother, and restore us to a state of wholeness, that we may bear witness to the miracle of your love. Amen.

Prayer to St. Jude:

Oh glorious apostle St. Jude, faithful servant and friend of Jesus, the name of the traitor who delivered thy beloved Master into the hands of His enemies has caused thee to be forgotten by many, but the Church honors and invokes thee universally as the patron of hopeless cases--of things despaired of. Pray for me who am so miserable; make use, I implore thee, of that particular privilege accorded thee of bringing visible and speedy help where help is almost despaired of. Come to my assistance in this great need, that I may receive the consolations and succor of heaven in all my necessities, tribulations and sufferings, particularly—completely heal and protect   SOPHIA —and that I may bless God with thee and all the elect throughout eternity. I promise thee, O blessed St. Jude, to be ever mindful of this great favor, and I will never cease to honor thee as my special and powerful patron, and to do all in my power to encourage devotion to thee. Amen

Prayer to St. Michael (Long Version)

O Glorious Prince of the heavenly host, Saint Michael the Archangel, defend us in the battle and fearful warfare that we are waging against the principalities and powers, against the rulers of this world of darkness, against the evil spirits. Come thou to the assistance of men, whom Almighty God created immortal, making them in His own image and likeness and redeeming them at a great price from the tyranny of Satan. Fight this day the battle of the Lord with thy legions of holy Angels, even as of old thou didst fight against Lucifer, the leader of the proud spirits and all his rebel angels, who were powerless to stand against thee, neither was their place found any more in heaven. And that great dragon was cast forth, the ancient serpent, who is called the devil and satan, who seduces the whole world; and he was cast forth upon Earth, and his angels were sent with him.

But behold! the ancient enemy of mankind and a murderer from the beginning has been fiercely aroused. Changing himself into an angel of light, he goes about with the whole multitude of the wicked spirits to invade the earth and blot out the Name of God and of His Christ, to plunder, to slay, and to consign to eternal damnation the souls that have been destined for a crown of everlasting life. This wicked serpent, like an unclean torrent, pours into men of depraved minds and corrupt hearts the poison of his malice, the spirit of lying, impiety and blasphemy, and the deadly breath of impurity and every form of vice and iniquity.

Be favorable to Thy Church, the Bride of the Lamb without spot, whose enemies have filled to overflowing with gall and inebriated with wormwood. They have laid profane hands upon Her most sacred treasures. Where the See of the most blessed Peter and the Chair of Truth has been constituted as a light to the nations, there they have placed a throne of their abomination and impiety; so that with the Pastor struck, they may prevail to disperse the flock.

Therefore, most invincible Leader, be with the people of God against this spiritual wickedness and bring about victory. Thou art venerated by Holy Church as Her guard and patron; Thou art glorified as our defender against the impious powers of earth and of hell. Unto thee the Lord hath handed over the souls of the redeemed to be placed in happiness above.

Entreat the God of peace, to obliterate satan beneath our feet, lest he prevail further to hold men captive, and to injure the Church. Offer our prayers in the sight of the Most High, so that the mercy of the Lord may swiftly overtake us, and apprehend the dragon, the ancient serpent, who is the devil and satan, and send him bound into the abyss, so that he may seduce the nations no more.

Henceforth having been confided to thy escort and protection, we sacred ministers by the authority of the Holy Mother Church [if recited by a cleric of the order of exorcist or above, say instead: by our authority], do undertake to repel the infestations of diabolical deceit in the Name of Jesus Christ, Our God and Lord.

Behold the Cross of the Lord; be scattered hostile powers.
The Lion of the tribe of Juda has conquered, the root of David.
Let Thy mercies be upon us, O Lord.
As we have hoped in Thee.
O Lord, hear my prayer.
And let my cry come unto Thee.
The Lord be with you all.
And with thy spirit.

Let us pray.
O God, and Father of Our Lord Jesus Christ, we invoke Thy Holy Name, and we humbly implore Thy clemency so that, through the intercession of Mary, the Immaculate ever-Virgin Mother of God, of blessed Michael the Archangel, of blessed Joseph, the Spouse of the same blessed Virgin, of the blessed Apostles Peter and Paul, and of all the Saints, Thou may deign to offer us aid against satan, and all the other unclean spirits, who wander through the world to injure the human race and to destroy souls. This book publishes today, and apparently Amazon is going to suppress my five-star review, so I'm posting it here:

I was the editor on Pale Dread, and it was such a fun job. It’s a plot-driven adventure story and at the same time a hilarious sendup of life (and the federal bureaucracy) in the absurd times we’re living through. It’s huge fun to read, with food for thought to ponder as well.
I can’t help laughing whenever I think of the dialogue between our hero—Fitz, the novel’s protagonist, a State Department guy who is the target of both the Deep State (because the Trump admin has promoted him him) and his malevolent wife at the FBI (long and interesting story)—and Fitz’s new friend Buck, a celibate homosexual who has glommed onto the Traditional Latin Mass—and thus also finds himself in the FBI’s crosshairs—because the gay lifestyle is no longer a way to be transgressive.
Here's a slice from their conversation at a funeral the two of them are attending at the National Cathedral for (or so they think) a fallen colleague:

“‘At this time, if someone would like to offer a reflection, come forward and share what the Spirit has put on your heart.’
“A lengthy silence ensued. Buck produced a flask and took a swig.
“‘Buckburns do not leave slain comrades unattended on the field of battle,’ Buck stage-whispered as he rose and strode for the altar. . . . .
“‘Thank you, madame father,’ he began with a nod to the celebrant, before turning to the dozen or so congregants.
“‘. . . Let us pray for this departed soul, this fallen brother . . . who passed from this world in a state, well, let’s be candid, a state of spiritual exile: without benefit of communion or reconciliation or extreme unction. Cut off, extra unam, veram ecclesiam, excommunicamus, anathematis sententia, if I’m conjugating correctly—spiritual collateral damage of that rebellious faction that, like Lucifer and his fallen legions, lured a third of Christendom away from the one, holy, Catholic, and apostolic Church and into perdition five hundred and one winters ago, casting generations into outer darkness, wherein dwell the Devil and his fallen brood. . . .’
“The priestess waved down an usher. . . .
“Buck lowered his head with solemnity and walked to his seat. Passing a wide-eyed woman in her pew, perhaps a relative, Buck halted and extended his hand with a statesmanlike gravitas, and she took it with apprehension.
“‘Well, I think that went well,’ he said to Fitz as he sat down. ‘If you can speak the truth and console, you’ve done God’s own work. Or at least that of the apostles, or whatever.’
The priestess stepped to the rostrum.
“‘Let us pray. We pray for Jonathan Kendell Brackenbury, a faithful servant . . .’
“‘Dammit, man,’ said Fitz in a suppressed whisper. ‘We’re at the wrong funeral. We’re at the wrong funeral!’
“‘We are? What was your man’s name?’
“‘Kalsomine. Bob Kalsomine. God!’
“‘Yes, all right. Well, that’s a relief. Hopefully the others are where they should be.’
“‘Where we’re supposed to be. Let’s go—now.’
“‘I feel bad leaving such a poorly attended funeral. Corporal work of mercy and all that.’
“‘Let’s go. Let the dead bury their dead.’
“’I was always curious how that worked exactly.’”

El-Sayed Is Lying About The Bizarre Alliance Upending Michigan
By Chloe Trapanotto
Welcome to Michigan in 2026.

Patriotism is frowned upon. 9/11 is treated like a branding problem. Terrorists are the victims. And the most skin-crawling endorsement in the state’s Senate race came from a flannel-loving, fastidious fart who thinks 3,000 murdered Americans is, like, not that bad, because the bodies would barely fill a Division III hockey rink.

It’s hard to keep up with everything that happened last week alone, but we’ll do our best. Let’s meet the cast of this sickening soap opera. 

Hasan Piker is a leftist influencer who campaigns alongside Democrat candidates, pushing a shared vision of a darkened, daunting, DSA future. He’s said that “America deserved 9/11,” that the goal is to “destroy the white race,” and that people should “motherf*ck the U.S. Constitution and motherf*ck this country.”

He’s a peach. And he’s very close friends with Abdulrahman Mohamed El-Sayed, the terror-sympathizer running for Senate in Michigan.

El-Sayed shares the exact same, warped, vile views as his boo-thang, but is now trying to run from his public past faster than you can say Abdulrahman — including but not limited to his comment, “You may not hate Muslims, but I’ll tell you, Muslims definitely hate you,” his mourning of the Muslims killed post-9/11 “in the name of my country,” his advocacy for Sharia law in America, and his attendance at Islamic conventions just days before 9/11, where the imam declared “America is going down.”

Then this week, this anti-American cheeseball was endorsed by Tucker Carlson.

Carlson, who left the Republican Party and doesn’t understand for the life of him why algebra contains variables, used his newsletter to shrug at the 3,000 Americans killed on 9/11, because those numbers “could barely fill a Division III hockey arena.” He then said there was “nothing remotely crazy” about El-Sayed’s suggestion that 9/11 remembrance often fails to “center” the Muslims scarred in the aftermath. Meanwhile, it’s absolutely crazy and insane to ever “center” 9/11 around the Muslims scarred in the aftermath. 9/11 is about remembering the American lives lost on that terrible day. Then remembering who killed them. Then remembering how anyone with a functioning moral compass could treat that sentence as negotiable.

Tucker has obviously had too many of his own ALP nicotine pouches, because he then went on to say that El-Sayed’s opponent, Mike Rogers, must be kept “far away from Washington.”

No, you faux-forester, flannel-wearing freak. Abdul El-Sayed — whose mother has ties to literal terror groups, whose father-in-law is among the top leaders of the Muslim Brotherhood, who is a left-of-Bernie-style communist, and who thinks football features “toxic masculinity” and deep-rooted racism — is who needs to be kept light-years away from Washington. Better yet, America.

This terrible political soap came to a head this week when Hasan Piker accidentally told on his girlfriend, El-Sayed. Piker (whom El-Sayed is trying to avoid like the plague he is) went on his livestream and acknowledged that El-Sayed’s 9/11 video statement “noticeably did not center” the Muslim victims of 9/11. He then admitted that’s because Abdul El-Sayed is a Muslim man, and if you’re a Muslim man running for Senate, unfortunately, in this current media environment, “you can’t say the f*cking truth.”

Uh oh!

Did Piker just admit his partner in crime is engaging in taqiyya? The Islamic concept that allows Muslims to lie to advance their political goals?

Yes. Yes, he did.

The quiet part has been screamed aloud, yet again. Abdulrahman Mohamed El-Sayed would love to only center the Muslims who were killed during the War on Terror, in response to the deadliest terror attack against innocent Americans in recorded history, because he too secretly believes we deserved it, but he can’t until he’s elected.

He will try to walk back every damning comment he’s ever made in the lead-up to November to appear more moderate. But there’s no putting this genie back in the bottle.

Every sane person is fully aware of who he is and what the stakes are. The choice, not only in this race but in countless others across the country, is a pro-American candidate versus an anti-American candidate. The pro-American candidate brings anti-terrorism attitudes, pro-capitalism ideals, USA pride, and policies that let you make your bag, raise your family, and live a quiet life while they get out of your way. The anti-American candidate forgives terror, hates innovation, creation, and free markets, constantly derides this land, and would handicap every freedom that allows for success and your pursuit of the American dream — which El-Sayed believes can only be found in Canada, among the moose, where the healthcare is “free” and ambition politely dies.

It’s sickening to see how fast we’ve succumbed to our enemies’ wishes in such a short amount of time, and how easy it was. All our foes had to whisper was that they had “free” things to offer, and promise that with them, you didn’t have to work hard to get what you deserve, because after all, hard work is a cult, and the sin of sloth is less a sin and more a salvation.

They’re openly showing you exactly what and who they are. The Trojan horse isn’t hiding anything this time; it’s made of glass, and we’re wheeling it through the gates with our eyes open. When our once-formidable country burns, we’ll have no one to blame but ourselves.

🚨 GUNNY’S ADVENTURES BREAKING NEWS 🚨

💥 PROTESTERS DISRUPT BESSENT HEARING AS DEBT, IRAN AND $5,000 CHECKS TAKE CENTER STAGE

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s annual testimony before the House Financial Services Committee began in chaos as protesters repeatedly interrupted his opening statement.

Approximately six demonstrators stood one after another, condemning the war with Iran and the administration’s sanctions campaign.

Some carried signs reading “Sanctions Kill Iranians,” while others accused Bessent of being a war criminal.

U.S. Capitol Police removed the protesters, allowing the hearing to continue.

Those accusations were protest statements—not legal findings or conclusions reached by the committee.

📉 TREASURY YIELDS HIT A 19-YEAR HIGH

The most important economic issue involved the 10-year Treasury yield, which climbed above 5% and reached its highest level since 2007.

That benchmark affects borrowing costs throughout the economy, including mortgage rates, business loans and other forms of credit.

Bessent initially attributed the rise to “global issues,” including instability across international bond markets.

Under questioning, however, he acknowledged that the federal government’s continuing budget deficit is also part of the pressure driving yields higher.

Lawmakers challenged Bessent over whether the administration’s economic and fiscal policies were contributing to rising borrowing costs.

Bessent defended the administration’s record and argued that the American economy remains strong.

🛒 INFLATION AND OIL PRESSURE

Democratic lawmakers connected continued inflation pressure to higher oil prices, the Iran war and the administration’s economic policies.

Bessent pushed back, blaming much of the country’s inflation problem on the previous administration and arguing that Americans are better off under President Trump.

He pointed to private-sector job growth, rising real wages and an Atlanta Federal Reserve model projecting approximately 4.4% annualized economic growth during the third quarter.

That Atlanta Fed number is a real-time economic estimate—not the government’s final official GDP calculation.

💵 DID THE TREASURY BUYBACK WORK?

Bessent also defended the Treasury Department’s recent repurchase of longer-term government debt.

The operation was intended to improve liquidity and reduce pressure inside the Treasury market.

Long-term yields continued climbing afterward, but Bessent argued that the buyback was still successful because it was followed by two exceptionally strong Treasury auctions.

The hearing did not establish what bond yields would have done without the intervention, so claims that the operation either solved the problem or completely failed go beyond what can currently be proven.

💰 THE PROPOSED $5,000 CHECKS

Bessent faced direct questions about President Trump’s proposal to send Americans $5,000 payments if Republicans retain control of Congress.

Bessent said Treasury has been working on possible ways to issue the payments without increasing the national debt or federal deficit.

He declined to explain how that would work.

Bessent also left open the possibility that the administration might attempt to issue the payments without congressional approval, while saying he would work with House Speaker Mike Johnson if legislation were required.

At this point, there is no publicly released funding mechanism, eligibility standard, payment date or settled explanation of the administration’s legal authority.

The checks are a proposal—not approved or scheduled payments.

🇨🇳 CHINA AND IRAN

Bessent confirmed that he plans to meet Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng this weekend ahead of an expected meeting between President Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping.

Iran’s financial connections with China are expected to be part of those discussions.

The United States is attempting to isolate Iran financially and target the foreign institutions, shipping networks and companies helping Tehran move oil and money around existing sanctions.

⚠️ WHAT THE HEARING ESTABLISHED

The hearing confirmed that the 10-year Treasury yield crossed 5% and that Bessent considers the federal deficit one factor behind the increase.

It confirmed that Bessent continues to defend the Treasury’s debt-buyback operation as successful despite long-term yields continuing to rise.

It also confirmed that Treasury has been examining possible methods for distributing the proposed $5,000 payments.

The hearing did not establish how those payments would be funded, who would qualify, when they could be issued or whether congressional authorization would be required.

📌 THE BOTTOM LINE

The protesters created the hearing’s loudest moments, but the unresolved economic questions carry the greatest consequences.

Treasury yields above 5% can increase borrowing costs far beyond Washington and Wall Street, affecting mortgages, loans and financing throughout the economy.

Bessent defended the administration’s economic record and offered explanations for the pressure facing the bond market.

However, the hearing ended without a detailed funding plan for the proposed $5,000 checks or a clear path for bringing long-term borrowing costs back under control.

The shouting dominated the opening.

The debt, borrowing costs and unanswered financial details are what Americans should remember.

— Gunny 🫡

“Fix the Facts. Keep the Mission.”

"American oil executives say the global fuel crisis they had warned about for months has now arrived, as inventories shrink, strategic reserves lose their ability to cushion the market, and attacks remove more Middle Eastern supply.

The latest blow came from an attack on Saudi Arabia’s East-West pipeline, a critical route that allows crude exports to bypass the Strait of Hormuz.

Analysts estimate the disruption has stranded at least 2.5 million barrels a day from an already tight market, according to The Wall Street Journal.

“All these mechanisms helped to mitigate the price and supply risk,” Chevron chief executive Mike Wirth said at an energy conference in Austin, Texas.

“Those have largely now played out, and we don’t have nearly the buffers in the system that we did when it began.”

Buffers Run Down
Commercial fuel inventories have been falling globally for more than six months, while strategic crude reserves offer increasingly limited scope for further releases.
That has left the market more exposed to fresh disruptions through the Strait of Hormuz and attacks on alternative export infrastructure.

U.S. crude prices have risen 19% over the past three weeks to about $101 a barrel as attacks across the Middle East multiply.

Iran has targeted tankers traversing the Strait, while Houthi militants operating from Yemen have struck Saudi infrastructure and military sites.
The damaged East-West pipeline runs from the Abqaiq oil field to Yanbu al-Bahr on the Red Sea.

Wirth said he saw little reason to expect prices to retreat quickly.

“I wish I could tell you that I saw some reason why things would ease, but it’s difficult right now to see that happen,” he said.

Diesel Emerges as Key Risk
The squeeze is increasingly visible in refined fuels.

Diesel has climbed to a record $6.23 a gallon, while gasoline has rebounded to $4.32 after slipping below $4 during the summer.

Some analysts are already fielding investor questions over when higher fuel costs will begin to restrain consumer spending.

White House Seeks More Supply
The Trump administration has maintained that the disruption will be temporary and is looking to Venezuela and higher U.S. refining capacity for additional supply.

U.S. officials have pursued deals intended to increase Venezuelan oil production and met refining executives in early September to discuss expanding domestic fuel-making capacity.

Interior Secretary Doug Burgum rejected speculation that Washington was seriously considering a temporary ban on U.S. exports of refined fuels such as diesel.
“We will do anything that helps the price at home,” Burgum said. “But we’re also going to be smart about it.”

Energy executives and administration officials have maintained regular contact since the conflict began, including discussions between company chiefs and Energy Secretary Chris Wright.

Conflict Raises Longer-Term Risk
Concern inside the industry has intensified as ships and energy infrastructure face attacks in both directions.

China is adding to the supply pressure. After relying heavily on its own crude stockpiles for months, the world’s largest oil importer has recently increased purchases from international suppliers, analysts said.

That return to the market comes as the buffers that previously absorbed disruptions are being depleted.

Executives from ExxonMobil, Chevron and ConocoPhillips had warned U.S. officials in March that a prolonged closure of the Strait of Hormuz could eventually create shortages of refined products, including diesel.

Their concern was that inventories, strategic reserves and alternative routes could soften the impact only for a limited period.

With stocks falling, reserves constrained and Saudi bypass infrastructure now under attack, oil executives say that limit has been reached."

text:
Saudi Israeli Contacts Mediated by the United States to Confront the Houthis Amid Mounting Pressure on Riyadh

AIDL International Foundation
AIDL Center for Peace and Security Policy

Expert Commentary
Prepared and analyzed by: 
Adnan Ali, Strategic Expert

15 September 2026

According to Israeli reports citing unnamed diplomatic sources, and in the absence of official confirmation from Riyadh, Israel, or the United States Central Command as of 15 September 2026. 
If these reports prove accurate, they would reveal a deeper shift in the regional security architecture and a widening gap between those willing to support Saudi Arabia and those prepared to bear the cost of fighting alongside it.

The significance of this issue does not begin with the possibility of contact between Saudi Arabia and Israel, It begins at the point where Riyadh encountered the operational limits of its alliance network, Reuters reported, citing three informed sources, that Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman requested direct U.S, military assistance against the Houthis, but Washington declined to carry out strikes and instead offered intelligence sharing and assistance with target identification.

At the same time, Israeli reports emerged claiming that Saudi Arabia had made an indirect request and that contacts had taken place through the United States Central Command to obtain Israeli intelligence support,The narrative later developed into reports alleging that intelligence had in fact been provided to Riyadh. However, this has not yet received official confirmation from Saudi Arabia, Israel, or the United States, nor has the existence of joint operational cooperation been independently established.

Yet the convergence in timing between the Saudi request, the Crown Prince’s meeting with the Commander of U.S, Central Command, and Israeli accounts of indirect contacts reveals a strategic dilemma that extends beyond the accuracy of the circulating details, Saudi Arabia is not facing an absence of allies, It is facing a gap between those capable of enabling it and those willing to bear the cost of war alongside it.

What Has Been Confirmed and What Has Not:

What has been officially confirmed is that Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman received Admiral Brad Cooper, Commander of U.S, Central Command, in Jeddah on 14 September 2026, The meeting was officially described as covering bilateral relations and developments in the region, with no announcement of contact with Israel, mediation, or intelligence sharing.

As for the request for U.S, military intervention, Reuters reported it on the basis of three informed sources, According to the report, Washington did not agree to conduct direct strikes against the Houthis, but offered intelligence and assistance with target identification, No official Saudi confirmation has been issued regarding the reported details of the request.

The account of contact with Israel originated in Israeli media channels, On 13 September, Israel Hayom reported, citing unnamed regional diplomatic sources, that Saudi Arabia had made an indirect request through CENTCOM for information and assistance related to the threat in Bab al Mandab.

Subsequent Israeli reports referred to Saudi Israeli contacts mediated by the United States and went as far as claiming that intelligence assistance had been provided to Riyadh, However, this narrative has remained dependent on unnamed sources, and no official confirmation has been issued by the parties concerned specifying the nature or scope of the information allegedly transferred or establishing the existence of an ongoing security arrangement.

Methodologically, four distinct stages must be separated,The first is an indirect Saudi request reported by unnamed sources,The second is alleged contacts mediated by the United States,The third is the transfer of intelligence claimed by Israeli reports but not officially or independently confirmed, The fourth is operational cooperation or joint operations, for which there is no publicly established evidence. Moving directly from the first stage to the fourth turns analytical assessment into an unsupported conclusion.

Escalating Houthi Threats to Shipping Linked to Saudi Arabia:

Houthi threats against shipping linked to Saudi Arabia and the maritime corridor have intensified, However, vessel traffic through Bab al Mandab has not stopped entirely, It would therefore be inaccurate to reduce the situation to a complete closure of the strait or a comprehensive blockade,The more precise assessment is that the Houthis have increased the cost of navigation, expanded their capacity to threaten maritime traffic, and acquired advanced leverage near one of the world’s most important maritime corridors.

Why CENTCOM:

If the reports are accurate, U S Central Command did not act as a conventional political mediator, Rather, it functioned as a security interface capable of transmitting requirements and coordinating capabilities between two parties that do not maintain publicly declared diplomatic relations.

This formula would give Riyadh access to specialized capabilities without forcing it to bear the political cost of direct and public contact, It would also allow Israel to provide limited assistance without appearing as a principal party to a new war, while enabling Washington to manage the support network and control the level of escalation while keeping U S forces outside direct confrontation.

Accordingly, CENTCOM would not merely represent a channel for transmitting messages, If the account is confirmed, it could become a platform for integrating intelligence, distributing roles, and controlling the degree of political exposure of each party,This would not establish the existence of normalization or a Saudi Israeli alliance, but it could point to functional security cooperation preceding a political settlement or formal diplomatic announcement.

Washington Supports Saudi Arabia but Does Not Want to Own Its War:

The available facts do not support the conclusion that Washington has abandoned Riyadh, The United States has demonstrated a willingness to provide intelligence and targeting assistance, but has placed a clear ceiling on direct combat intervention.

This position reflects careful U S risk management, Leaving Saudi Arabia alone in the face of major escalation could weaken the credibility of the U S security partnership in the Gulf, At the same time, conducting direct strikes could open an additional front whose escalation toward Iran and the Red Sea could become difficult to control.

Washington is therefore not distancing itself from Saudi security, It is distancing itself from owning Saudi Arabia’s war, It is moving from the role of the power that directly fights the confrontation to the role of the power that manages the support network and enables its partners to carry it out.

Intelligence alone, however, does not create deterrence, It may improve warning and the accuracy of strikes, but it cannot stop an adversary unless it is combined with operational military capability, rapid political decision making, and consequences that the adversary believes will actually follow if defined thresholds are crossed.

Israel Is Not Rejecting Cooperation as Much as Seeking to Define Its Political Price and Limits:

Israel’s continued reluctance to enter a direct confrontation with the Houthis reflects its interest in avoiding automatic involvement at the forefront of a new war on behalf of another party, Its stated priorities remain limiting Houthi capabilities and protecting maritime navigation.

In this context, a more significant development has emerged:

Oded Ailam, former head of the Counterterrorism Division in Mossad, advanced a proposal calling on Israel to capitalize on Iranian and Houthi pressure on Saudi Arabia by offering a security package that would include real time intelligence, air defense, protection of oil facilities, and operational capabilities related to threats originating from Yemen, in exchange for an immediate, public, signed Saudi Israeli peace agreement.

Naturally, this proposal does not represent an officially declared position of the Israeli government at this stage, It is nevertheless analytically significant because it reveals a perspective within research circles with a security background that views Saudi Arabia’s current security predicament as an opportunity to obtain a strategic political return, The central issue here is therefore not security cooperation in itself, but the possibility of linking an urgent security need to a long term sovereign political commitment, thereby transforming security capabilities into a costly negotiating instrument.

Even so, this remains the opinion of a former official and researcher, It should not be treated as an officially declared set of Israeli demands or as evidence that such conditions have actually been presented to Saudi Arabia.

The Saudi Deterrence Gap:

The Saudi deterrence gap in this case consists of four interconnected levels, The first is a capability gap between possessing a large military arsenal and maintaining the sustained ability to detect mobile launch platforms, intercept complex attacks, and protect critical facilities and maritime routes, The second is a commitment gap between allies willing to provide support and their unwillingness to engage in direct combat intervention,The third is a command and integration gap that emerges when intelligence, target identification, and decision making are distributed among capitals with different political calculations,The fourth, and potentially most serious gap, is the failure of the Yemeni government and the anti Houthi camp to unify decision making and build an effective capacity for confrontation.

The Houthis Are Testing the Alliance Network, Not Only Saudi Borders:

The Houthi escalation does not target Saudi cities and facilities alone, It also tests the cohesion of the deterrence network surrounding the Kingdom,The longer the response time and the lower the cost imposed on the group, the greater its ability to use missiles, drones, and threats to maritime navigation as instruments of political coercion and as leverage to improve its negotiating position.

The Houthi advance along the western coast, its control over the coastline, and its control over several strategic locations, including Mayyun Island near Bab al Mandab, also provide the group with greater capacity for surveillance, threat projection, and disruption of navigation. However, this does not establish that the Houthis possess absolute operational control over the strait or a complete ability to close it.

The Four Expected Scenarios Ahead:

Scenario One:
The continuation of U S technical and intelligence support without direct combat intervention, while Saudi Arabia and its Yemeni partners remain at the forefront of military operations,This is the scenario most consistent with the currently established information. However, it may improve tactical effectiveness without restoring strategic deterrence.

Scenario Two:
Limited and covert Saudi Israeli intelligence cooperation, if the circulating reports are confirmed, Such cooperation could focus on early warning, tracking missile and drone launch platforms, and analyzing maritime movements, This pathway could provide additional capabilities, but it would carry a significant political cost for Saudi Arabia and would not, by itself, be sufficient to alter the balance of the conflict.

Scenario Three:
The expansion of coordination under a U S umbrella into a regional air and maritime defense architecture, without the declaration of a bilateral Saudi Israeli alliance,This pathway could strengthen protection, but it would require unified command structures and clear rules governing intelligence sharing and decision making.

Scenario Four:
The failure of indirect support to contain the escalation, leading to a broader military response or the formation of a combat coalition, The probability of this scenario would increase if a major attack struck a strategic Saudi facility, if attacks caused large scale human casualties, or if maritime navigation were severely disrupted،This would be the highest risk scenario because it could transform Yemen and the Red Sea into a multi party regional front.

The Makkah Agreement and the Absence of Allies:

The Makkah Agreement on collective defense among Saudi Arabia, Türkiye, and Pakistan establishes a framework for collective defense and provides that an armed attack against any of the three states shall be considered an attack against all of them, Nevertheless, it has not so far translated into combat intervention in Yemen, Pakistan stated that any military response under the agreement had not been discussed, despite reaffirming its commitment to the agreement, while Türkiye limited its response to condemning the attacks against Saudi Arabia without making any statement regarding the possibility of military participation.

The Required Response:

Restoring deterrence must not turn into an open ended war that reproduces the humanitarian cost in Yemen, Any military operations must comply with the rules of international humanitarian law, particularly the principles of distinction and proportionality and the obligation to take all feasible precautions to protect civilians and civilian objects.

The military coalition led by Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates since their intervention in Yemen in 2015 has previously been implicated in numerous documented violations associated with aerial bombardment affecting civilians, some of which may amount to war crimes and crimes against humanity.

Conclusion:
If Saudi Israeli contacts are confirmed, they would not constitute a minor security detail, They would represent an indicator of an emerging security architecture operating below the threshold of formal normalization, Washington would manage the support channel, Israel would provide specialized capabilities, and Saudi Arabia would bear the decision to confront and its associated costs. This would not constitute a fully integrated deterrence architecture. It would amount to the outsourcing of some of its core functions.

The proposal to link security support to an immediate peace agreement adds an even more sensitive dimension to the broader picture, particularly at the Saudi domestic and regional levels,It demonstrates how a deterrence gap can evolve from a military problem into a political bargaining instrument, and how an actor possessing capabilities that Riyadh needs may seek to convert those capabilities into long term strategic influence.

Saudi Arabia does not suffer from a shortage of allies,It faces difficulty in converting the political value of its alliances into a unified and rapid response.

The Houthis, meanwhile, do not need to defeat every alliance surrounding Saudi Arabia, They need only to test the slowest decision within those alliances and exploit the distance between the party that holds the intelligence, the party that identifies the target, the party that fires, and the party that ultimately bears the consequences of retaliation. It is precisely within that distance that the Saudi deterrence gap is taking shape.

Note:
The views expressed in this commentary are those of the author and do not necessarily reflect the position of the Center.

text:
In one of its most recent reports, @SemiAnalysis_  confirmed that NVIDIA decided to rely on 8-hi HBM for Rubin Ultra. Compared to the B300, which features 288 GB of HBM per GPU, the capacity for the standard Rubin model drops to 192 GB. While 12-hi HBM was still the standard for the Blackwell architecture, a return to 8-hi HBM is now on the horizon, even though just a year ago the industry expected 16-hi HBM to become increasingly widespread. This news marks a departure from the long-standing trend of increasing memory capacity with each new GPU generation. The decision to stack fewer DRAM dies vertically may seem like a step backward at first glance. In fact, it makes sense for cost, manufacturing, and capacity reasons—and could also signal a potential shift in the balance of power in the DRAM market, from which the Chinese manufacturer CXMT could benefit.

In recent months, numerous AI models have been released that outperform their predecessors. Such a performance improvement is often accompanied by a higher number of parameters, which indicates greater model capacity. However, this scaling also increases the demand for memory and memory bandwidth. Consequently, the decision was made over time to increase the number of vertically stacked DRAM dies to provide the GPU with more memory. However, as the stack height increases, so do manufacturing complexity, yield risks, and, consequently, costs.

With each additional DRAM layer, manufacturing complexity increases, and with it the risk that an HBM stack will not meet the required quality standards. Declining yields can consequently drive up costs significantly. Flawlessly connecting the layers via TSVs becomes increasingly complex as the stack height increases. Added to this are thermal and mechanical challenges that become harder to manage as the stack height increases, causing the price per GB to rise disproportionately. SemiAnalysis also points out an interesting correlation between increasing token counts and the utilization of available memory. Consequently, what matters is not only the maximum HBM capacity but also how efficiently the available memory capacity can be utilized per inference workload. Under these conditions, 8-hi HBM may offer a more attractive balance of capacity, yield, cost, and manufacturing reliability compared to 12-hi HBM.

However, the decision was likely not made based solely on technological considerations. Rather, it also fits into the context of the tight global DRAM supply, which has been further exacerbated by the AI boom—better known as “RAMageddon.” Since the AI boom began, data centers have increasingly taken center stage. Running AI models requires GPUs organized in racks, which must read data from memory to generate tokens. Due to the enormous memory requirements of LLMs, standard DRAM—such as that used in smartphones or PCs—is insufficient. HBM bundles multiple DRAM dies into a vertical stack and connects them to the processor via TSVs with a particularly wide interface. HBM functions as directly attached high-speed memory for GPUs and other AI accelerators. The market for advanced HBM is currently dominated by SK hynix, Samsung, and Micron. The HBM boom ties up significant DRAM manufacturing resources, thereby intensifying competition for available capacity among the AI, PC, and smartphone markets; and the fact that the three heavyweights are shifting their focus more toward HBM production has a direct impact on the DRAM market.

The Chinese company CXMT, in particular, benefited from the exponential rise in demand for DRAM, with its global DRAM market share reaching the 10% mark for the first time in the second quarter of 2026. In the second quarter of last year, this figure was still at 5%. CXMT is the largest manufacturer of DRAM memory chips in China and already counts Chinese industry leaders such as Alibaba Cloud and Huawei among its customers. Although the overall global market continues to be dominated by SK Hynix, Samsung, and Micron, CXMT has now become the fourth-largest DRAM producer worldwide and is rapidly expanding its production in the low- to mid-price segment through a massive increase in manufacturing capacity. This could lead to an interesting division of labor in the long term. While SK hynix, Samsung, and Micron are focusing an ever-increasing portion of their resources on HBM, CXMT could gain additional market share in the traditional DRAM market. In the short to medium term, this could provide a solution to the HBM and DRAM shortages, provided CXMT is able to ramp up its production capacity. Although such a scenario is within the realm of possibility, it still seems a long way off.

The global DRAM crisis prompted a company like Apple to look for another reliable DRAM manufacturer, leading them to test CXMT’s memory chips. Ultimately, the project failed less due to technical issues than to political and economic hurdles. Apple planned to use these chips primarily in devices sold exclusively on the Chinese market, as no U.S. exemption was strictly required for that purpose. At the same time, Apple lobbied in Washington to obtain approval for global use. However, they did not receive this approval. Added to this were political restrictions against CXMT, including the U.S. designation of the company on a relevant list maintained by the U.S. Department of Defense. The U.S. Department of Defense accuses the company of having ties to the Chinese military, a claim CXMT vehemently denies. Further barriers included political pressure from the U.S. government, which classified CXMT as a security risk, as well as complicated price negotiations between Apple and CXMT, during which the latter refused to accept a price reduction. A final decision will most likely be made after the Trump-Xi summit this month.

The shift back from 12-hi to 8-hi HBM should therefore be viewed less as a technological step backward and more as an optimization in response to changing economic and manufacturing conditions. However, the global DRAM shortage makes it clear that the next phase of AI hardware will not be determined solely by maximum memory capacity. Yield, costs, manufacturing capacity, and geopolitical access to memory are becoming increasingly critical factors as well. CXMT could benefit from this—at least in theory. After all, the political barriers that Apple has already encountered also highlight the limits of this potential realignment.

It is yet another "Utopian" book:
The kind of book that—thanks to AI—can now be churned out in a week, yet one that no one buys; and even those who do buy it never actually study it...

The autonomy of municipalities, civil society, and similar citizen initiatives is already protected under the #C40 framework—though without going to extremes or pushing civil society to the point of replacing the State.

======
Let’s see how AI reads a book that was itself created by AI in just one week—summarized here in five minutes:

The book *The Polycentric Republic*, written by David Thunder, offers a philosophical and moral critique of the modern sovereign, centralized State, proposing instead an alternative model of civil order known as the "polycentric republic."

Broadly speaking, the book’s main points are:

Critique of the centralized State:
The author argues that the modern State amasses excessive, homogeneous power, intervening in and attempting to micromanage many aspects of public and private life (such as education, the economy, and healthcare) through bureaucracy. He cites the collateral damage and ineffectiveness of centralized interventions during the COVID-19 pandemic as examples.

The importance of social pluralism (Ecology of sustainability):
He maintains that human beings require a wide variety of independent communities and associations—such as churches, schools, universities, businesses, cooperatives, and municipalities—to flourish and achieve well-being. These groups possess local knowledge that no remote technocrat could possibly master.

Defense of corporate autonomy:
He advocates that these non-state associations should have the right to self-regulate and govern their own internal affairs in accordance with their missions and values, rather than being subject to the directives of a central government.

The Polycentric Republic:
He proposes a social order built from the "bottom up" through inter-group cooperation based on a form of federalism that is not strictly territorial. In this system, power is dispersed among multiple governing bodies that cooperate under the rule of law, yet none exercises supreme or monopolistic authority over the others.

In short, the text seeks to rethink contemporary governance by moving away from a state-centric approach, offering an institutional and ethical framework that protects the freedom of local communities to flourish.

text:
#ICYMI | Behind the public disputes that continue to divide Israel and several Arab governments, a remarkably different picture is emerging on the military front.

Senior military commanders from the United States, Israel, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Bahrain, Kuwait, Qatar, Jordan and Egypt met in Germany last week for discussions focused on the war with Iran and the wider regional security situation. The gathering was organized by U.S. Central Command commander Adm. Brad Cooper and brought together senior officers from countries that, despite significant political differences, increasingly share a common security environment.

IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir was among those attending. He briefed the participating commanders on Israeli military operations across several fronts during the preceding six months, providing a direct assessment of the evolving battlefield and the threats facing Israel and its regional partners.

While similar gatherings of senior military officials have taken place before, the meeting was particularly significant because it was the first such gathering since the outbreak of the war with Iran.

Its importance lies not simply in who attended, but in what the meeting reveals about the changing architecture of Middle Eastern security.

The political relationship between Israel and a number of Arab states remains complicated. The war in Gaza has generated deep disagreements, particularly over Palestinian statehood and the future of the conflict. Yet those disputes have not erased a parallel convergence among their military establishments over the threats posed by Iran and its regional network.

The United States remains at the center of that emerging architecture. Through CENTCOM, Washington has increasingly facilitated military coordination between Israel and Arab partners, including cooperation on air and missile defense, intelligence and surveillance, maritime security and the protection of critical infrastructure.

That cooperation has become even more consequential as the conflict has expanded beyond Iran itself. The Houthis’ attacks in the Red Sea, threats to Saudi Arabia and the vulnerability of shipping through the Strait of Hormuz have underscored how interconnected the region’s security challenges have become.

For the Gulf states in particular, the strategic calculation is increasingly pragmatic. Whatever their disagreements with Israel over Gaza or the Palestinian issue, they face the same Iranian missile, drone and proxy threats. They also have a direct interest in keeping the Red Sea, Gulf shipping lanes and energy infrastructure secure.

The German meeting therefore offers a revealing glimpse of a regional reality that is often obscured by political rhetoric: military cooperation is advancing even where diplomatic relations remain strained.

This does not mean that an integrated Arab-Israeli military alliance has suddenly emerged. Nor does it erase the profound political differences among the participants. But it does demonstrate that years of quiet security coordination have created channels of communication and operational cooperation that can be activated when circumstances demand it.

The Iran war appears to be accelerating that process.

The result could be a more structured U.S.-backed regional security network in which Israel and key Arab states cooperate against common threats while maintaining separate political positions on the Palestinian question.

In other words, normalization may be politically contested, but security cooperation is proving considerably more resilient.

And that distinction could become one of the most important strategic consequences of the war.

CactusJake45 168.81, Fairies of Neverland 132.25

Neverland Has Fallen

Fairies of Neverland scored 132.25 points in Week 1. That total would have defeated four teams and placed Fairies comfortably in the respectable half of the league.

Instead, Fairies drew CactusJake45 and was forced to watch three running backs conduct a live demolition of the entire kingdom.

Jahmyr Gibbs scored 35.75. Jonathan Taylor added 25.75. David Montgomery contributed 29.55. Together, the Cactus backfield produced 91.05 points.

By the fourth quarter, Tinker Bell had been placed on injured reserve, Captain Hook had requested a trade and Peter Pan had finally decided to grow up so he could leave this godforsaken roster.

Isaiah Likely then scored 29.50 because apparently the three tanks rolling through Neverland needed air support.

Fairies Did Not Play Badly—which Somehow Makes This Worse

Bijan Robinson delivered 32.60 points. Ladd McConkey scored 19.80. Parker Washington added 19.75. Rhamondre Stevenson contributed 15.45.

That is normally the foundation of a winning lineup. Against Cactus, it was the fantasy equivalent of bringing a very respectable butter knife to a tank battle.

Omarion Hampton scored 8.40 in his first game after Fairies surrendered major draft capital to acquire him. League sources confirm that nobody inside the organization is panicking.

Those same sources were last seen shredding copies of the trade agreement and asking whether conditional draft picks can be added retroactively.

A Fairies executive defended Hampton after the game:

“We didn’t trade multiple premium picks for one week of production. We traded them for years of everyone bringing this up whenever he scores fewer than ten.”

The Quarterback Decision That Wouldn’t Have Mattered

Dak Prescott started and scored 18.50. Tyler Shough scored 33.00 on the bench.

That is a difference of 14.50 points, which sounds disastrous until you remember Fairies lost by 36.56. Starting Shough would not have saved Neverland. It simply would have allowed the kingdom to burn slightly later into the evening.

The lineup mistake is therefore being classified as negligent but not outcome-determinative.

The front office has requested that this distinction appear prominently in all legal documents.

CactusJake Has Become Completely Unbearable

Cactus entered the season ranked tenth and left Week 1 ranked second. This is exactly how dangerous levels of confidence develop.

Sources close to the organization say ownership has already rejected several offers for Gibbs. One proposal reportedly included two first-round picks, a starting receiver and an apology for the preseason ranking.

Cactus responded that the apology was “a good starting point.”

The bold prediction that Gibbs would eventually be traded for a historic haul suddenly looks less like comedy and more like an active hostage negotiation.

Sources Close to the Fairy Kingdom Speak

One anonymous employee described the postgame scene as “confusing and extremely dusty.”

Another source claimed the organization attempted to relocate the team facility away from the desert, only to discover that all roads were being occupied by Cactus running backs.

A senior official close to Fairies offered the final assessment:

“We scored 132 points. We did our fucking jobs. What exactly were we supposed to do—shoot Gibbs with a tranquilizer dart?”

We also tried to get a comment on the Fairies star WR AJ Brown destined for the IR for at least 4 games.. there was a refusal to comment there as well.

Final Verdict

Fairies was not exposed as a bad team. It was exposed as a team unfortunate enough to stand between CactusJake and a completely irrational Week 1 power trip.

The kingdom is damaged but not destroyed. Bijan remains elite, McConkey looked excellent and 132.25 suggests Fairies can compete immediately.

But the official record says 0–1, Omarion Hampton’s trade receipt has been laminated, and somewhere in the desert CactusJake is still driving a tank through the ruins while screaming about respect.

text:
Zelensky publicly offered Putin an 'energy truce.' Peskov called it 'unconditionally good.' Then came the invoice: lift sanctions, insure our tankers, let Russian crude back into your market. That's not a peace deal — it's a ransom note with your heating bill as collateral.

1. Zelensky publicly proposed an 'energy truce' — no strikes on each other's energy or critical infrastructure — and Peskov reportedly called it 'unconditionally good.' Same news cycle: Ukraine reportedly flew 222 drones at Russian regions; Russia reportedly struck an Odesa-region logistics center plus a cargo ship and RO-RO ferry in Chornomorsk port. Talking and bombing on the same clock.

2. The signal: Moscow is converting a Ukrainian olive branch into a sanctions-relief demand. Putin isn't asking for peace — one outlet cites demands for tanker insurance, an end to the price cap, and unrestricted Russian crude flows into global markets. The 'truce' is the wrapper; the content is unfreezing Russia's war chest.

3. War-wise, it doesn't advance anything. Lavrov reportedly said Russia won't halt combat during talks — so the freeze covers only energy targets while strikes on cities, ports, rail, and logistics continue. Today alone: a Geran-4 reportedly hit another Kyiv petrol station; one killed, twelve wounded in the Sviatoshynskyi district. Moscow gets to conserve expensive cruise munitions while grinding infrastructure at discount.

4. Markets: expect a Brent/WTI relief bid on headlines, then fade as Russia's conditions land — if any sanctions relief sticks, discounted Urals floods global markets and your gasoline drops while Western shale capex gets crushed. Defense names (Lockheed, RTX, Northrop) likely flat-to-up; this is theater, not demilitarization. Gold bids on collapse. Wheat neutral-bearish only if Black Sea ports stabilize — they won't while Chornomorsk burns.

5. Your wallet: if 'energy truce' headlines have you waiting for cheaper gas, read the second paragraph of Russia's response. Moscow's ask amounts to — let us sell you oil under sanctions protection while we keep bombing Kyiv's petrol stations. Your winter heating bill hinges on whether the EU holds the oil cap, not on what Zelensky offered. NATO isn't buying the pause either: Finland just announced a €290M Ukraine aid package (its 34th, second-largest ever), and Poland is reportedly negotiating E-2D Hawkeye buys. They're pricing in failure.

6. Timing: this drops days after Trump publicly told Zelensky to stop hitting Russian refineries. Kyiv is performing the restraint Washington asked for. Moscow is using the moment to extract the real prize — Western energy market access. Expect the next Trump–Putin call to be packaged as 'progress.' It won't be. It'll be Russia converting Trump's political win into a sanctions win.

Don't price in peace. Price in whose sanctions get traded for whose ceasefires — and that math always runs against your wallet.

"Saudi Arabia issued security alerts over a range of territory on Tuesday, including in the ​holy city of Mecca and second-largest city Jeddah, following a week of attacks from Iran-aligned fighters that have drawn it deeper into the Middle East war.
The alerts were swiftly lifted ‌and Saudi authorities did not immediately report whether any incoming projectiles had landed, nor was there any immediate claim of responsibility for attacks.
But the alerts were the widest ranging since an escalation in the conflict last week, and the alarm in Mecca was the first of the war in the city, which houses shrines sacred to all Muslims.
The Iran-aligned Houthis in Yemen have announced a number of major attacks on Saudi Arabia over the past week, including strikes on an air base ​on Monday they said were in retaliation for airstrikes on Yemen.

Crude oil should be flowing through the pipeline within days, U.S. Energy Secretary Chris ⁠Wright told CNBC on Tuesday.

The Iran-backed fighters launched a lightning advance along ​Yemen's western coast last week, culminating in the seizure of an island in the mouth of the Red Sea.

NEW THEATRE STRENGTHENS IRAN'S HAND
The escalation in a new theatre in the Middle East conflict has strengthened Iran's ​hand in its war with the U.S. and further jeopardised global oil supplies.
Officials from a Saudi-backed Yemeni government, which is based in the south of the country and opposes the Houthis, said the Saudi and Yemeni air forces had been responding to Houthi advances by stepping up aerial bombardment of Houthi targets. 
But the Yemeni officials acknowledged that the Houthis had now taken effective control ​over almost the entire western coast of the country along the Red Sea.

NEW OIL THREAT
Saudi Arabia's 1,200-km (745-mile) East-West Pipeline, which links its Gulf oil fields to the Red Sea, has been the Kingdom's principal export route while shipping through the Strait ‌of Hormuz has ⁠been disrupted by six months of war.

Since the pipeline was shut after Friday's attack, traders say a prolonged closure could cut off as much as 4% of global oil supply.
Riyadh has not said when operations might resume, but Wright said on the sidelines of a G20 energy meeting in Houston that he thought "it will be measured in days."
He said Saudi Arabia was taking steps to move more oil out of the Strait of Hormuz with assistance from the U.S. military.
The new Houthi presence in the Bab el-Mandeb, or "Gate of Tears", the strait at the mouth of the Red Sea, could further jeopardise that crucial export route.

Oil prices have risen since ​last week to levels unseen since May. Brent crude ​oil futures rose above $108 a barrel on ⁠Tuesday, while the politically sensitive average retail price of diesel in the U.S. hit a new all-time high of nearly $6.27 a gallon.

AMERICANS HESITANT TO STEP IN
Saudi Arabia has led a coalition battling the Houthis ​since 2015. The conflict had largely quietened under a ceasefire in recent years, but fighting reignited this month, with the Houthis pushing back forces aligned ​with the internationally recognised government.
The ⁠United States, which bombed the Houthis for two months last year, now faces a dilemma: whether to stand by and risk new threats to the global economy, or offer military support to the Saudis and risk being pulled into another costly theatre of war.
Saudi Arabia's Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman met Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi in Cairo on Tuesday. A statement from the Egyptian presidency after the meeting said the leaders stressed the need to ⁠ensure freedom and ​security of navigation in the Bab el-Mandeb and the Red Sea.
The crown prince met the U.S. regional military commander, Admiral Brad ​Cooper, in Jeddah on Monday, and phoned President Donald Trump last week seeking military support, which so far has been limited to intelligence aid."
